    (h : Function.Exact f g) :

name: Module.sum_neg_one_pow_finrank_eq_zero_of_longExact
statement:
theorem sum_neg_one_pow_finrank_eq_zero_of_longExact
    (hinj : Function.Injective (f 0))
    (hexact₂ : ∀ i, Function.Exact (f i) (g i))
    (hexact₃ : ∀ i, Function.Exact (g i) (δ i))
    (hexact₁ : ∀ i, Function.Exact (δ i) (f (i + 1)))
    (n : ℕ) [Subsingleton (A (n + 1))] :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ i *
      ((Module.finrank k (A i) : ℤ) - Module.finrank k (B i) + Module.finrank k (C i)) = 0

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.naturality
statement:
theorem naturality (η : HomogeneousNatTrans F G n)
    {X Y : C} (p r : ℤ) (hpn : p + n = r) (hnp : n + p = r)
    (f : (dgHom X Y).X p) :
    dgComp p n r hpn (F.map p f) (app η Y) =
      (n * p).negOnePow •
        dgComp n p r hnp (app η X) (G.map p f)

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.interchange
statement:
theorem interchange (α : HomogeneousNatTrans F F' n)
    (β : HomogeneousNatTrans G G' m) (r : ℤ) (hnm : n + m = r)
    (hmn : m + n = r) :
    composition (F.comp G) (F'.comp G) (F'.comp G') n m r hnm
        (whiskerRight α G) (whiskerLeft F' β) =
      (m * n).negOnePow •
        composition (F.comp G) (F.comp G') (F'.comp G') m n r hmn
          (whiskerLeft F β) (whiskerRight α G')

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.interchange_app
statement:
theorem interchange_app (α : HomogeneousNatTrans F F' n)
    (β : HomogeneousNatTrans G G' m) (r : ℤ) (hnm : n + m = r)
    (hmn : m + n = r) (X : C) :
    dgComp n m r hnm (G.map n (app α X)) (app β (F'.obj X)) =
      (m * n).negOnePow •
        dgComp m n r hmn (app β (F.obj X)) (G'.map n (app α X))

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerLeft_app

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerLeft_composition

    whiskerLeft F (composition G H I n m r h η θ) =

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerRight_composition
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_composition (η : HomogeneousNatTrans F G n)

    whiskerRight (composition F G H n m r h η θ) K =

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerRight_whiskerLeft

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerRight_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_whiskerRight (α : HomogeneousNatTrans F F' n)
    (G : DGFunctor D E) (K : DGFunctor E B) :
    whiskerRight (whiskerRight α G) K = whiskerRight α (G.comp K)

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerRight_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem whiskerRight_zero (K : DGFunctor D E) :
    whiskerRight (0 : HomogeneousNatTrans F G n) K = 0

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.IsClosed.hcomp
statement:
theorem IsClosed.hcomp {α : HomogeneousNatTrans F F' n}
    {β : HomogeneousNatTrans G G' m} (hα : IsClosed α) (hβ : IsClosed β)
    (r : ℤ) (h : n + m = r) :
    IsClosed (HomogeneousNatTrans.hcomp α β r h)

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.differential_hcomp
statement:
theorem differential_hcomp (α : HomogeneousNatTrans F F' n)
    (β : HomogeneousNatTrans G G' m) (r : ℤ) (h : n + m = r) :
    differential (hcomp α β r h) =
      hcomp α (differential β) (r + 1) (by omega) +
        m.negOnePow • hcomp (differential α) β (r + 1) (by omega)

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.hcomp_add_left
statement:
theorem hcomp_add_left (α α' : HomogeneousNatTrans F F' n)
    (β : HomogeneousNatTrans G G' m) (r : ℤ) (h : n + m = r) :
    hcomp (α + α') β r h = hcomp α β r h + hcomp α' β r h

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.hcomp_add_right
statement:
theorem hcomp_add_right (α : HomogeneousNatTrans F F' n)
    (β β' : HomogeneousNatTrans G G' m) (r : ℤ) (h : n + m = r) :
    hcomp α (β + β') r h = hcomp α β r h + hcomp α β' r h

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.hcomp_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hcomp_app (α : HomogeneousNatTrans F F' n)
    (β : HomogeneousNatTrans G G' m) (r : ℤ) (h : n + m = r) (X : C) :
    app (hcomp α β r h) X =
      dgComp n m r h (G.map n (app α X)) (app β (F'.obj X))

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.hcomp_app_swap
statement:
theorem hcomp_app_swap (α : HomogeneousNatTrans F F' n)
    (β : HomogeneousNatTrans G G' m) (r : ℤ) (h : n + m = r) (h' : m + n = r)
    (X : C) :
    app (hcomp α β r h) X =
      (m * n).negOnePow •
        dgComp m n r h' (app β (F.obj X)) (G'.map n (app α X))

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.hcomp_assoc
statement:
theorem hcomp_assoc (α : HomogeneousNatTrans F F' n)
    (β : HomogeneousNatTrans G G' m) (γ : HomogeneousNatTrans H H' k)
    (nm mk s : ℤ) (hnm : n + m = nm) (hmk : m + k = mk) (hs : nm + k = s)
    (hs' : n + mk = s) :
    hcomp (hcomp α β nm hnm) γ s hs = hcomp α (hcomp β γ mk hmk) s hs'

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.hcomp_eq_smul_swap
statement:
theorem hcomp_eq_smul_swap (α : HomogeneousNatTrans F F' n)
    (β : HomogeneousNatTrans G G' m) (r : ℤ) (h : n + m = r) (h' : m + n = r) :
    hcomp α β r h =
      (m * n).negOnePow •
        composition (F.comp G) (F.comp G') (F'.comp G') m n r h'
          (whiskerLeft F β) (whiskerRight α G')

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.hcomp_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hcomp_id (α : HomogeneousNatTrans F F' n) (G : DGFunctor D E) :
    hcomp α (id G) n (add_zero n) = whiskerRight α G

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.hcomp_zero_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hcomp_zero_left (β : HomogeneousNatTrans G G' m) (r : ℤ)
    (h : n + m = r) :
    hcomp (0 : HomogeneousNatTrans F F' n) β r h = 0

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.hcomp_zero_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hcomp_zero_right (α : HomogeneousNatTrans F F' n) (r : ℤ)

    hcomp α (0 : HomogeneousNatTrans G G' m) r h = 0

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.horizontalComposition_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem horizontalComposition_apply (α : HomogeneousNatTrans F F' n)
    (β : HomogeneousNatTrans G G' m) (r : ℤ) (h : n + m = r) :
    horizontalComposition F F' G G' n m r h α β = hcomp α β r h

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.id_hcomp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem id_hcomp (F : DGFunctor C D) (β : HomogeneousNatTrans G G' m) :
    hcomp (id F) β m (zero_add m) = whiskerLeft F β

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.id_hcomp_id
statement:
theorem id_hcomp_id (F : DGFunctor C D) (G : DGFunctor D E) :
    hcomp (id F) (id G) 0 (add_zero 0) = id (F.comp G)

statement:
lemma dgComp_units_smul_left {X Y Z : C} (p q r : ℤ) (h : p + q = r) (c : ℤˣ)

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.dgComp_units_smul_right

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.op_dgComp_apply
statement:
lemma op_dgComp_apply {X Y Z : Cᵒᵖ} (p q r : ℤ) (h : p + q = r)
    (f : (dgHom Y.unop X.unop).X p)
    (g : (dgHom Z.unop Y.unop).X q) :
    dgComp (C := Cᵒᵖ) p q r h f g =
      (p * q).negOnePow • dgComp q p r (by omega) g f

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.prod_d_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma prod_d_apply {X Y : C × D} (p q : ℤ)

    ((dgHom (C := C × D) X Y).d p q).hom f =

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.prod_dgComp_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma prod_dgComp_apply {X Y Z : C × D} (p q r : ℤ) (h : p + q = r)
    (f : ((dgHom X.1 Y.1).X p) × ((dgHom X.2 Y.2).X p))
    (g : ((dgHom Y.1 Z.1).X q) × ((dgHom Y.2 Z.2).X q)) :
    dgComp (C := C × D) p q r h f g =
      (dgComp p q r h f.1 g.1, dgComp p q r h f.2 g.2)

lemma prodComp_apply (c₁ : A₁ →+ B₁ →+ M₁) (c₂ : A₂ →+ B₂ →+ M₂)

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.shiftComp_apply
statement:
lemma shiftComp_apply (m n : ℤ) {X Y Z : C} (a b c : ℤ) (h : a + b = c)
    (f : (dgHom X Y).X a) (g : (dgHom Y Z).X b) :
    shiftComp m n a b c h f g = ((b - n) * m).negOnePow • dgComp a b c h f g

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.shiftComp_assoc
statement:
lemma shiftComp_assoc (m n l : ℤ) {W X Y Z : C} (a b d ab bd abd : ℤ)
    (hab : a + b = ab) (hbd : b + d = bd) (habd : ab + d = abd)
    (f : (dgHom W X).X a) (g : (dgHom X Y).X b) (k : (dgHom Y Z).X d) :
    shiftComp (m + n) l ab d abd habd (shiftComp m n a b ab hab f g) k =
      shiftComp m (n + l) a bd abd (by omega) f (shiftComp n l b d bd hbd g k)

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.shiftComp_dgId_left
statement:
lemma shiftComp_dgId_left (n : ℤ) {X Y : C} (b : ℤ) (g : (dgHom X Y).X b) :
    shiftComp 0 n 0 b b (zero_add b) (dgId X) g = g

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.shiftComp_dgId_right
statement:
lemma shiftComp_dgId_right (m : ℤ) {X Y : C} (a : ℤ) (f : (dgHom X Y).X a) :
    shiftComp m 0 a 0 a (add_zero a) f (dgId Y) = f

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.shiftComp_leibniz
statement:
lemma shiftComp_leibniz (m n : ℤ) {X Y Z : C} (a b c c' : ℤ) (h : a + b = c) (hc : c + 1 = c')
    (f : (dgHom X Y).X a) (g : (dgHom Y Z).X b) :
    shiftD (m + n) c c' (shiftComp m n a b c h f g) =
      shiftComp m n a (b + 1) c' (by omega) f (shiftD n b (b + 1) g) +
        (b - n).negOnePow • shiftComp m n (a + 1) b c' (by omega) (shiftD m a (a + 1) f) g

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.shiftComp_zero_zero
statement:
lemma shiftComp_zero_zero {X Y Z : C} (a b c : ℤ) (h : a + b = c) :
    shiftComp (X := X) (Y := Y) (Z := Z) 0 0 a b c h = dgComp a b c h

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.shiftD_apply
statement:
lemma shiftD_apply (m : ℤ) {X Y : C} (a b : ℤ) (f : (dgHom X Y).X a) :
    shiftD m a b f = m.negOnePow • ((dgHom X Y).d a b).hom f

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.shiftD_shiftD
statement:
lemma shiftD_shiftD (m : ℤ) {X Y : C} (a b c : ℤ) (f : (dgHom X Y).X a) :
    shiftD m b c (shiftD m a b f) = 0

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.shiftD_zero
statement:
lemma shiftD_zero {X Y : C} (a b : ℤ) :
    shiftD (C := C) (X := X) (Y := Y) 0 a b = ((dgHom X Y).d a b).hom

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.shiftFunctor_dgHom_X
statement:
lemma shiftFunctor_dgHom_X (m : ℤ) {X Y : C} (p : ℤ) :

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.shiftFunctor_dgHom_d

statement:
lemma mk_comp_mk₀ [HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom.{w} W M X Y]
    [HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom.{w} W M Y Z] [HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom.{w} W M X Z]
    [HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom.{w} W M Z Z]
    {m : M} (f : ShiftedHom X Y m) (m₀ : M) (hm₀ : m₀ = 0) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    (SmallShiftedHom.mk W f).comp (SmallShiftedHom.mk₀ W m₀ hm₀ g)
        (by rw [hm₀, zero_add]) =
      SmallShiftedHom.mk W (f ≫ g⟦m⟧')

    [HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom.{w} W M Z Z]
    (m₀ : M) (hm₀ : m₀ = 0) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    (SmallShiftedHom.mk₀ W m₀ hm₀ f).comp (SmallShiftedHom.mk₀ W m₀ hm₀ g)

statement:
theorem exists_totalCycleRefinement_zero_le
    (p q n : ℤ) (h : p + q = n)
    (hE : (ShortComplex.mk ((K.X p).d (q-1) q) ((K.X p).d q (q+1))
      ((K.X p).d_comp_d _ _ _)).Exact)
    {A : C} (x : A ⟶ (K.total (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).X n)
    (hx : x ≫ (K.total (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).d n (n+1) = 0)
    (hlow : ∀ r s : ℤ, ∀ (hr : r+s=n), r < p → x ≫ totalProjection K r s n hr = 0) :
    ∃ (A' : C) (π : A' ⟶ A) (_ : Epi π) (y : A' ⟶ (K.X p).X (q-1)),
      let z := ((ComplexShape.up ℤ).ε p • y) ≫
        K.ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℤ) p (q-1) (n-1) (by change p+(q-1)=n-1; omega)
      ((π ≫ x - z ≫ (K.total (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).d (n-1) n) ≫
        (K.total (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).d n (n+1) = 0) ∧
      (∀ r s : ℤ, ∀ (hr : r+s=n), r ≤ p →
        (π ≫ x - z ≫ (K.total (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).d (n-1) n) ≫
          totalProjection K r s n hr = 0)

statement:
lemma total_d_comp_totalProjection (p q n : ℤ) (h : p + q = n) :
    (K.total (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).d n (n+1) ≫
      totalProjection K p (q+1) (n+1) (by omega) =
    totalProjection K (p-1) (q+1) n (by omega) ≫ (K.d (p-1) p).f (q+1) +
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ).ε p •
        (totalProjection K p q n h ≫ (K.X p).d q (q+1))

name: HomologicalComplex₂.ι_totalColumnConeIso_hom_source
statement:
theorem ι_totalColumnConeIso_hom_source (p q n : ℤ) (h : p+q=n) :
    ((CochainComplex.mappingCone.inl
      ((HomologicalComplex₂.flipFunctor C (up ℤ) (up ℤ)).map f)).v
        (q+1) q (by omega)).f p ≫
      (columnCone f).ιTotal (up ℤ) p q n
        (by change p+q=n; exact h) ≫
      (totalColumnConeIso f).hom.f n =
    (p.negOnePow • K.ιTotal (up ℤ) p (q+1) (n+1)
      (by change p+(q+1)=n+1; omega)) ≫
      (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inl
        (HomologicalComplex₂.total.map f (up ℤ))).v (n+1) n (by omega)

name: HomologicalComplex₂.ι_totalColumnConeIso_hom_target
statement:
theorem ι_totalColumnConeIso_hom_target (p q n : ℤ) (h : p+q=n) :
    ((CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr
      ((HomologicalComplex₂.flipFunctor C (up ℤ) (up ℤ)).map f)).f q).f p ≫
      (columnCone f).ιTotal (up ℤ) p q n
        (by change p+q=n; exact h) ≫
      (totalColumnConeIso f).hom.f n =
    L.ιTotal (up ℤ) p q n (by change p+q=n; exact h) ≫
      (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr
        (HomologicalComplex₂.total.map f (up ℤ))).f n

name: GradedModule.DegreeZeroLocalization.awayMk_add
statement:
theorem awayMk_add {f : A} {e : ι} (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 e) (n : ℕ) (p q : M)
    (hp : p ∈ 𝓜 (n • e)) (hq : q ∈ 𝓜 (n • e)) :
    awayMk hf n (p + q) (add_mem hp hq) = awayMk hf n p hp + awayMk hf n q hq

name: GradedModule.DegreeZeroLocalization.awayMk_deg_congr
statement:
theorem awayMk_deg_congr {f : A} {e₁ e₂ : ι} (h : e₁ = e₂) (hf₁ : f ∈ 𝒜 e₁) (hf₂ : f ∈ 𝒜 e₂)
    (n : ℕ) (p : M) (hp₁ : p ∈ 𝓜 (n • e₁)) (hp₂ : p ∈ 𝓜 (n • e₂)) :
    awayMk hf₁ n p hp₁ = awayMk hf₂ n p hp₂

name: GradedModule.DegreeZeroLocalization.awayMk_eq_awayMk_iff
statement:
theorem awayMk_eq_awayMk_iff [IsDomain A] [Module.IsTorsionFree A M] {f : A} {e : ι}
    (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 e) (hf0 : f ≠ 0) {n m : ℕ} {p q : M} (hp : p ∈ 𝓜 (n • e))
    (hq : q ∈ 𝓜 (m • e)) :
    awayMk hf n p hp = awayMk hf m q hq ↔ f ^ m • p = f ^ n • q

name: GradedModule.DegreeZeroLocalization.awayMk_eq_zero_iff
GradedModule.DegreeZeroLocalization.awayMk_shift
statement:
theorem awayMk_shift {f : A} {e : ι} (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 e) (n t : ℕ) (p : M)
    (hp : p ∈ 𝓜 (n • e)) (hfp : f ^ t • p ∈ 𝓜 ((n + t) • e)) :
    awayMk hf (n + t) (f ^ t • p) hfp = awayMk hf n p hp

name: GradedModule.DegreeZeroLocalization.awayMk_sum
statement:
theorem awayMk_sum {f : A} {e : ι} (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 e) (n : ℕ) {β : Type*} (s : Finset β)
    (p : β → M) (hp : ∀ b, p b ∈ 𝓜 (n • e)) :
    awayMk hf n (∑ b ∈ s, p b) (sum_mem fun b _ => hp b) =
      ∑ b ∈ s, awayMk hf n (p b) (hp b)

name: GradedModule.DegreeZeroLocalization.awayMk_zero
statement:
theorem awayMk_zero {f : A} {e : ι} (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 e) (n : ℕ) :
    awayMk (𝓜 := 𝓜) hf n (0 : M) (zero_mem (𝓜 (n • e))) = 0

theorem coe_awayMk {f : A} {d : ι} (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 d) (n : ℕ) (m : M)

    ((awayMk hf n m hm : DegreeZeroLocalization 𝒜 𝓜 (.powers f)) :

theorem coe_faceMap {g₁ g₂ h : A} {e : ι} (hh : h ∈ 𝒜 e)

    (z : DegreeZeroLocalization 𝒜 𝓜 (.powers g₁)) :

name: GradedModule.DegreeZeroLocalization.exists_awayMk
statement:
theorem exists_awayMk {f : A} {e : ι} (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 e) (hf0 : ∀ n : ℕ, f ^ n ≠ 0)
    (z : DegreeZeroLocalization 𝒜 𝓜 (.powers f)) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (m : M) (hm : m ∈ 𝓜 (n • e)), z = awayMk hf n m hm

name: GradedModule.DegreeZeroLocalization.exists_awayMk_pair
statement:
theorem exists_awayMk_pair {f : A} {e : ι} (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 e) (hf0 : ∀ n : ℕ, f ^ n ≠ 0)
    (z₁ z₂ : DegreeZeroLocalization 𝒜 𝓜 (.powers f)) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (p₁ p₂ : M) (hp₁ : p₁ ∈ 𝓜 (n • e)) (hp₂ : p₂ ∈ 𝓜 (n • e)),
      z₁ = awayMk hf n p₁ hp₁ ∧ z₂ = awayMk hf n p₂ hp₂

GradedModule.DegreeZeroLocalization.faceLift_mk
statement:
theorem faceLift_mk {g₁ g₂ h : A} (hgh : g₁ * h ∈ Submonoid.powers g₂)
    (hg : g₁ * h = g₂) (m : M) (n : ℕ) :
    faceLift (M := M) hgh
        (LocalizedModule.mk m (⟨g₁ ^ n, n, rfl⟩ : Submonoid.powers g₁)) =
      LocalizedModule.mk (h ^ n • m) (⟨g₂ ^ n, n, rfl⟩ : Submonoid.powers g₂)

name: GradedModule.DegreeZeroLocalization.faceMap_awayMk
statement:
theorem faceMap_awayMk {g₁ g₂ h : A} {e e₁ : ι} (hh : h ∈ 𝒜 e) (hg₁ : g₁ ∈ 𝒜 e₁)
    (hgh : g₁ * h ∈ Submonoid.powers g₂) (hg : g₁ * h = g₂)
    (hg₂ : g₂ ∈ 𝒜 (e + e₁)) (n : ℕ) (p : M) (hp : p ∈ 𝓜 (n • e₁))
    (hres : h ^ n • p ∈ 𝓜 (n • (e + e₁))) :
    faceMap (𝓜 := 𝓜) hh hgh hg (awayMk hg₁ n p hp) = awayMk hg₂ n (h ^ n • p) hres

name: GradedModule.DegreeZeroLocalization.faceMap_mk
statement:
theorem faceMap_mk {g₁ g₂ h : A} {e : ι} (hh : h ∈ 𝒜 e)
    (hgh : g₁ * h ∈ Submonoid.powers g₂) (hg : g₁ * h = g₂)
    (c : NumDenSameDeg 𝒜 𝓜 (.powers g₁)) (n : ℕ) (hn : g₁ ^ n = (c.den : A)) :
    faceMap (𝓜 := 𝓜) hh hgh hg (mk c) =
      mk ({ deg := n • e + c.deg
            num := ⟨h ^ n • (c.num : M),
              SetLike.GradedSMul.smul_mem (SetLike.pow_mem_graded n hh) c.num.2⟩
            den := ⟨g₂ ^ n, by
              rw [show g₂ ^ n = h ^ n * (c.den : A) by
                rw [← hg, mul_pow, mul_comm (g₁ ^ n) (h ^ n), hn]]
              exact SetLike.mul_mem_graded (SetLike.pow_mem_graded n hh) c.den.2⟩
            den_mem := ⟨n, rfl⟩ } : NumDenSameDeg 𝒜 𝓜 (.powers g₂))

GradedModule.DegreeZeroLocalization.linearEquivOfMemIff_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem linearEquivOfMemIff_mk {σN : Type*} [SetLike σN M] [AddSubgroupClass σN M]
    (𝓝 : ι → σN) [SetLike.GradedSMul 𝒜 𝓝]
    (hmem : ∀ i (m : M), m ∈ 𝓜 i ↔ m ∈ 𝓝 i) (c : NumDenSameDeg 𝒜 𝓜 S) :
    linearEquivOfMemIff (𝒜 := 𝒜) (𝓜 := 𝓜) (S := S) 𝓝 hmem (mk c) =
      mk { deg := c.deg
           num := ⟨(c.num : M), (hmem c.deg (c.num : M)).mp c.num.2⟩
           den := c.den
           den_mem := c.den_mem }

name: GradedModule.DegreeZeroLocalization.mapOfLE_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapOfLE_mk {T : Submonoid A} (h : S ≤ T) (c : NumDenSameDeg 𝒜 𝓜 S) :
    mapOfLE (𝒜 := 𝒜) (𝓜 := 𝓜) h (mk c) = mk
      { deg := c.deg
        num := c.num
        den := c.den
        den_mem := h c.den_mem }

name: GradedModule.DegreeZeroLocalization.mk_eq_mk_iff
statement:
theorem mk_eq_mk_iff (p q : NumDenSameDeg 𝒜 𝓜 S) :
    mk p = mk q ↔
      ∃ u : S,
        (u : A) • (q.den : A) • (p.num : M) =
          (u : A) • (p.den : A) • (q.num : M)

name: GradedModule.DegreeZeroLocalization.mk_smul_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_smul_mk (c' : HomogeneousLocalization.NumDenSameDeg 𝒜 S)
    (c : NumDenSameDeg 𝒜 𝓜 S) :
    HomogeneousLocalization.mk c' • (mk c : DegreeZeroLocalization 𝒜 𝓜 S) =
      mk { deg := c'.deg + c.deg
           num := ⟨(c'.num : A) • (c.num : M),
             SetLike.GradedSMul.smul_mem c'.num.2 c.num.2⟩
           den := ⟨(c'.den : A) * (c.den : A),
             SetLike.mul_mem_graded c'.den.2 c.den.2⟩
           den_mem := S.mul_mem c'.den_mem c.den_mem }

name: GradedModule.DegreeZeroLocalization.smul_mk
statement:
theorem smul_mk (a : HomogeneousLocalization 𝒜 S) (c : NumDenSameDeg 𝒜 𝓜 S) :
    a • (mk c : DegreeZeroLocalization 𝒜 𝓜 S) =
      mk { deg := a.deg + c.deg
           num := ⟨a.num • (c.num : M),
             SetLike.GradedSMul.smul_mem a.num_mem_deg c.num.2⟩
           den := ⟨a.den * (c.den : A),
             SetLike.mul_mem_graded a.den_mem_deg c.den.2⟩
           den_mem := S.mul_mem a.den_mem c.den_mem }

name: GradedModule.GradedLinearMap.localized_mk
statement:

theorem localized_mk (f : GradedLinearMap (A := A) 𝓜 𝓝) (m : M) (s : S) :

name: GradedModule.GradedLinearMap.map_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_mk (f : GradedLinearMap (A := A) 𝓜 𝓝) (c : NumDenSameDeg 𝒜 𝓜 S) :

name: GradedModule.DegreeZeroLocalization.powersCongr_awayMk
statement:
theorem powersCongr_awayMk {f g : A} (h : f = g) {e : ι} (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 e) (hg : g ∈ 𝒜 e)
    (n : ℕ) (m : M) (hm : m ∈ 𝓜 (n • e)) :
    powersCongr (𝒜 := 𝒜) (𝓜 := 𝓜) h (awayMk hf n m hm) = awayMk hg n m hm

name: GradedModule.DegreeZeroLocalization.powersCongr_faceMap
statement:
theorem powersCongr_faceMap {g₁ g₁' g₂ g₂' w w' : A} {e : ι}
    (e₁ : g₁ = g₁') (e₂ : g₂ = g₂') (e₃ : w = w')
    (hw : w ∈ 𝒜 e) (hw' : w' ∈ 𝒜 e)
    (hgw : g₁ * w ∈ Submonoid.powers g₂) (hgw' : g₁' * w' ∈ Submonoid.powers g₂')
    (hg : g₁ * w = g₂) (hg' : g₁' * w' = g₂')
    (z : DegreeZeroLocalization 𝒜 𝓜 (.powers g₁)) :
    powersCongr (𝒜 := 𝒜) (𝓜 := 𝓜) e₂ (faceMap (𝓜 := 𝓜) hw hgw hg z) =
      faceMap (𝓜 := 𝓜) hw' hgw' hg' (powersCongr e₁ z)

name: GradedModule.DegreeZeroLocalization.powersCongr_symm_apply_apply
statement:
theorem powersCongr_symm_apply_apply {f g : A} (h : f = g)
    (z : DegreeZeroLocalization 𝒜 𝓜 (.powers f)) :
    (powersCongr (𝒜 := 𝒜) (𝓜 := 𝓜) h).symm (powersCongr h z) = z

name: GradedModule.DegreeZeroLocalization.powersCongr_symm_trans
statement:
theorem powersCongr_symm_trans {f g l : A} (h₀ : f = g) (e₁ : f = l) (h₁ : g = l)
    (u : DegreeZeroLocalization 𝒜 𝓜 (.powers g)) :
    powersCongr (𝒜 := 𝒜) (𝓜 := 𝓜) e₁ ((powersCongr h₀).symm u) = powersCongr h₁ u

name: GradedModule.DegreeZeroLocalization.powersCongr_trans
statement:
theorem powersCongr_trans {f g l : A} (h₁ : f = g) (h₂ : g = l)

name: GradedModule.smul_mem_intShift
GradedModule.DegreeZeroLocalization.intShiftLowerLinearEquiv_apply_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem intShiftLowerLinearEquiv_apply_mk (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 1) (d : ℤ) (e : ℕ) (hfS : f ∈ S)
    (c : NumDenSameDeg 𝒜 (intShift 𝒜 d) S) :
    intShiftLowerLinearEquiv 𝒜 hf d e hfS (DegreeZeroLocalization.mk c) =
      DegreeZeroLocalization.mk
        { deg := c.deg + e
          num := ⟨(c.num : A),
            (mem_intShift_sub_natCast_add 𝒜 d e c.deg (c.num : A)).mpr c.num.2⟩
          den := ⟨(c.den : A) * f ^ e, by
            simpa using SetLike.mul_mem_graded c.den.2 (SetLike.pow_mem_graded e hf)⟩
          den_mem := S.mul_mem c.den_mem (S.pow_mem hfS e) }

name: GradedModule.DegreeZeroLocalization.intShiftZeroLinearEquivOfMulMem_apply_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem intShiftZeroLinearEquivOfMulMem_apply_mk {h : A} {e : ℕ} (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 1)
    (h_deg : h ∈ 𝒜 e) (a b : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (hd : d = (a : ℤ) - b) (hfh : f * h ∈ S)
    (c : NumDenSameDeg 𝒜 (intShift 𝒜 d) S) :
    intShiftZeroLinearEquivOfMulMem 𝒜 hf h_deg a b d hd hfh
        (DegreeZeroLocalization.mk c) =
      DegreeZeroLocalization.mk
        { deg := c.deg + a * (1 + e)
          num := ⟨(c.num : A) * h ^ a * f ^ b,
            mul_pow_mul_pow_mem_intShift_zero 𝒜 hf h_deg a b d hd c.deg (c.num : A) c.num.2⟩
          den := ⟨(c.den : A) * (f * h) ^ a, by
            simpa using SetLike.mul_mem_graded c.den.2
              (SetLike.pow_mem_graded a (SetLike.mul_mem_graded hf h_deg))⟩
          den_mem := S.mul_mem c.den_mem (S.pow_mem hfh a) }

name: GradedModule.DegreeZeroLocalization.intShiftZeroLinearEquiv_apply_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem intShiftZeroLinearEquiv_apply_mk (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 1) (d : ℤ) (hfS : f ∈ S)
    (c : NumDenSameDeg 𝒜 (intShift 𝒜 d) S) :
    intShiftZeroLinearEquiv 𝒜 hf d hfS (DegreeZeroLocalization.mk c) =
      DegreeZeroLocalization.mk
        { deg := c.deg + d.toNat
          num := ⟨(c.num : A) * f ^ (-d).toNat,
            mul_pow_toNat_mem_intShift_zero 𝒜 hf d c.deg (c.num : A) c.num.2⟩
          den := ⟨(c.den : A) * f ^ d.toNat, by
            simpa using SetLike.mul_mem_graded c.den.2
              (SetLike.pow_mem_graded d.toNat hf)⟩
          den_mem := S.mul_mem c.den_mem (S.pow_mem hfS d.toNat) }

name: GradedModule.DegreeZeroLocalization.intShiftZeroLinearEquiv_symm_apply_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem intShiftZeroLinearEquiv_symm_apply_mk (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 1) (d : ℤ) (hfS : f ∈ S)
    (c : NumDenSameDeg 𝒜 (intShift 𝒜 0) S) :
    (intShiftZeroLinearEquiv 𝒜 hf d hfS).symm (DegreeZeroLocalization.mk c) =
      DegreeZeroLocalization.mk
        { deg := c.deg + (-d).toNat
          num := ⟨(c.num : A) * f ^ d.toNat,
            mul_pow_toNat_mem_intShift 𝒜 hf d c.deg (c.num : A) c.num.2⟩
          den := ⟨(c.den : A) * f ^ (-d).toNat, by
            simpa using SetLike.mul_mem_graded c.den.2

name: GradedModule.DegreeZeroLocalization.intShiftZeroLinearEquiv_transition
statement:
theorem intShiftZeroLinearEquiv_transition (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 1) {g : A} (hg : g ∈ 𝒜 1)
    (hfS : f ∈ S) (hgS : g ∈ S) (n : ℕ)
    (z : DegreeZeroLocalization 𝒜 (intShift 𝒜 (n : ℤ)) S) :
    ((intShiftZeroLinearEquiv 𝒜 hf (n : ℤ) hfS z : LocalizedModule S A)) =
      Localization.mk (g ^ n) (twistPowerOfMem (f := f) n hfS) •
        ((intShiftZeroLinearEquiv 𝒜 hg (n : ℤ) hgS z : LocalizedModule S A))

name: GradedModule.DegreeZeroLocalization.intShiftZeroModuleLinearEquiv_apply_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem intShiftZeroModuleLinearEquiv_apply_mk (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 1) (d : ℤ) (hfS : f ∈ S)
    (c : NumDenSameDeg 𝒜 (intShift 𝓜 d) S) :
    intShiftZeroModuleLinearEquiv 𝒜 𝓜 hf d hfS (DegreeZeroLocalization.mk c) =
      DegreeZeroLocalization.mk
        { deg := c.deg + d.toNat
          num := ⟨f ^ (-d).toNat • (c.num : M),
            pow_smul_mem_intShift_zero 𝒜 𝓜 hf d c.deg (c.num : M) c.num.2⟩
          den := ⟨(c.den : A) * f ^ d.toNat, by
            simpa using SetLike.mul_mem_graded c.den.2
              (SetLike.pow_mem_graded d.toNat hf)⟩
          den_mem := S.mul_mem c.den_mem (S.pow_mem hfS d.toNat) }

name: GradedModule.DegreeZeroLocalization.intShiftZeroModuleLinearEquiv_symm_apply_mk

theorem intShiftZeroModuleLinearEquiv_symm_apply_mk (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 1) (d : ℤ) (hfS : f ∈ S)

    (intShiftZeroModuleLinearEquiv 𝒜 𝓜 hf d hfS).symm (DegreeZeroLocalization.mk c) =

          den := ⟨(c.den : A) * f ^ (-d).toNat, by

name: GradedModule.DegreeZeroLocalization.natShiftLinearEquivOfMulMem_apply_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem natShiftLinearEquivOfMulMem_apply_mk {h : A} {e : ℕ} (h_deg : h ∈ 𝒜 e)
    (hfh : f * h ∈ S) (c : NumDenSameDeg 𝒜 (natShift 𝒜 d) S) :
    natShiftLinearEquivOfMulMem 𝒜 hf d h_deg hfh (DegreeZeroLocalization.mk c) =
      DegreeZeroLocalization.mk
        { deg := c.deg + d * (1 + e)
          num := ⟨(c.num : A) * h ^ d, by
            have hnum : (c.num : A) ∈ 𝒜 (c.deg + d) := c.num.2
            simpa [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_comm, ← add_assoc] using
              SetLike.mul_mem_graded hnum (SetLike.pow_mem_graded d h_deg)⟩
          den := ⟨(c.den : A) * (f * h) ^ d, by
            simpa using SetLike.mul_mem_graded c.den.2
              (SetLike.pow_mem_graded d (SetLike.mul_mem_graded hf h_deg))⟩
          den_mem := S.mul_mem c.den_mem (S.pow_mem hfh d) }

statement:
theorem transitionScalar_mul (n : ℕ) {g g' : A} (hgS : g ∈ S) (hg'S : g' ∈ S) :
    Localization.mk (g' ^ n) (twistPowerOfMem (f := g) n hgS) *
        Localization.mk (f ^ n) (twistPowerOfMem (f := g') n hg'S) =

name: Module.exists_finitely_presented_fixedTargetArrow_of_isLocalization
statement:
theorem Module.exists_finitely_presented_fixedTargetArrow_of_isLocalization
    {R A N T : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    (S : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization S A] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module A N] [IsScalarTower R A N]
    [Module.Finite A N] [AddCommGroup T] [Module R T]
    (β : N →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] T) :
    ∃ L : Submodule R N, Module.FinitePresentation R L ∧
      ∃ (f : L →ₗ[R] T) (e : N ≃ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] L),
        β = (IsLocalizedModule.mapExtendScalars S
          (TensorProduct.mk R A L 1) (TensorProduct.mk R A T 1) A f).comp
            e.toLinearMap

name: Module.exists_finitely_presented_fixedTerminalThreeTerm_of_isLocalization
statement:
theorem Module.exists_finitely_presented_fixedTerminalThreeTerm_of_isLocalization
    {R A M₀ M₁ T : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    (S : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization S A] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M₀] [Module R M₀] [Module A M₀] [IsScalarTower R A M₀]
    [AddCommGroup M₁] [Module R M₁] [Module A M₁] [IsScalarTower R A M₁]
    [Module.Finite A M₀] [Module.Finite A M₁]
    [AddCommGroup T] [Module R T]
    (d : M₀ →ₗ[A] M₁) (β : M₁ →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] T)
    (hz : β.comp d = 0) :
    ∃ (L₀ : Submodule R M₀) (L₁ : Submodule R M₁),
      Module.FinitePresentation R L₀ ∧ Module.FinitePresentation R L₁ ∧
      ∃ (d₀ : L₀ →ₗ[R] L₁) (f : L₁ →ₗ[R] T)
        (e₀ : M₀ ≃ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] L₀)
        (e₁ : M₁ ≃ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] L₁),
        f.comp d₀ = 0 ∧
        e₁.toLinearMap.comp d =
            (IsLocalizedModule.mapExtendScalars S
              (TensorProduct.mk R A L₀ 1) (TensorProduct.mk R A L₁ 1) A d₀).comp
                e₀.toLinearMap ∧
        β = (IsLocalizedModule.mapExtendScalars S
              (TensorProduct.mk R A L₁ 1) (TensorProduct.mk R A T 1) A f).comp
                e₁.toLinearMap

name: IsLocalizedModule.kerMap
statement:
theorem kerMap (a : M →ₗ[A] M') [ha : IsLocalizedModule S a]
    (b : N →ₗ[A] N') [hb : IsLocalizedModule S b]
    (g : M →ₗ[A] N) (g' : M' →ₗ[A] N') (h : g'.comp a = b.comp g) :
    IsLocalizedModule S (LinearMap.kerMap a b g g' h)

name: IsLocalizedModule.kernelMap
statement:
theorem kernelMap {M M' N N' : ModuleCat.{w} A}
    (a : M ⟶ M') [IsLocalizedModule S a.hom]
    (b : N ⟶ N') [IsLocalizedModule S b.hom]
    (g : M ⟶ N) (g' : M' ⟶ N') (h : g ≫ b = a ≫ g') :
    IsLocalizedModule S (kernel.map g g' a b h).hom

name: IsLocalizedModule.kernelNatTrans
statement:
theorem kernelNatTrans (F G : C ⥤ ModuleCat.{w} A)
    [F.PreservesZeroMorphisms] [G.PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteLimits G] (α : F ⟶ G)
    {X Y : C} (g : X ⟶ Y) [HasKernel g]
    [IsLocalizedModule S (α.app X).hom]
    [IsLocalizedModule S (α.app Y).hom] :
    IsLocalizedModule S (α.app (kernel g)).hom

name: LocalizedModule.awayToAwayRightLinearMap_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem awayToAwayRightLinearMap_mk
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (r s : R) (m : M) :
    awayToAwayRightLinearMap (M := M) r s
        (LocalizedModule.mk m (1 : Submonoid.powers r)) =
      LocalizedModule.mk m (1 : Submonoid.powers (r * s))

name: Submodule.localized'_awayToAwayRight_eq_span
statement:
theorem localized'_awayToAwayRight_eq_span
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (r s : R) (N : Submodule R M) :
    N.localized' (Localization.Away (r * s)) (Submonoid.powers (r * s))
        (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers (r * s)) M) =
      Submodule.span (Localization.Away (r * s))
        ((LocalizedModule.awayToAwayRightLinearMap (M := M) r s) ''
          (N.localized' (Localization.Away r) (Submonoid.powers r)
            (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers r) M) :
              Set (LocalizedModule.Away r M)))

name: Submodule.localized'_comap_awayToAwayRight_eq_span
statement:
theorem localized'_comap_awayToAwayRight_eq_span
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (r s : R) (P : Submodule (Localization.Away r) (LocalizedModule.Away r M)) :
    let fr := LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers r) M
    let frs := LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers (r * s)) M
    let α := LocalizedModule.awayToAwayRightLinearMap (M := M) r s
    ((P.restrictScalars R).comap fr).localized'
        (Localization.Away (r * s)) (Submonoid.powers (r * s)) frs =
      Submodule.span (Localization.Away (r * s)) (α '' (P : Set (LocalizedModule.Away r M)))

name: LocalizedModule.awayToAwayLeftLinearMap_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem awayToAwayLeftLinearMap_mk
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (r s : R) (m : M) :
    awayToAwayLeftLinearMap (M := M) r s
        (LocalizedModule.mk m (1 : Submonoid.powers s)) =
      LocalizedModule.mk m (1 : Submonoid.powers (r * s))

name: Submodule.localized'_away_mul_eq_span_awayToAwayLeft
statement:
theorem localized'_away_mul_eq_span_awayToAwayLeft
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (r s : R) (N : Submodule R M) :
    let fs := LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers s) M
    let frs := LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers (r * s)) M
    let α := LocalizedModule.awayToAwayLeftLinearMap (M := M) r s
    N.localized' (Localization.Away (r * s)) (Submonoid.powers (r * s)) frs =
      Submodule.span (Localization.Away (r * s))
        (α '' (N.localized' (Localization.Away s) (Submonoid.powers s) fs :
          Set (LocalizedModule.Away s M)))

name: Submodule.localized'_comap_awayToAwayLeft_eq_span
statement:
theorem localized'_comap_awayToAwayLeft_eq_span
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (r s : R) (P : Submodule (Localization.Away s) (LocalizedModule.Away s M)) :
    let fs := LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers s) M
    let frs := LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers (r * s)) M
    let α := LocalizedModule.awayToAwayLeftLinearMap (M := M) r s
    ((P.restrictScalars R).comap fs).localized'
        (Localization.Away (r * s)) (Submonoid.powers (r * s)) frs =
      Submodule.span (Localization.Away (r * s)) (α '' (P : Set (LocalizedModule.Away s M)))

    {R : Type u} [CommSemiring R] {R' : Type v} [CommSemiring R']
    [Algebra R R'] {M : Type w} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]
    {M' : Type x} [AddCommMonoid M'] [Module R M'] [Module R' M']
    [IsScalarTower R R' M'] (S : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization S R']
    (f : M →ₗ[R] M') [IsLocalizedModule S f]

    ∃ N : Submodule R M, N.FG ∧ N.localized' R' S f = P

name: Submodule.exists_fg_two_away_localized_submodule_of_overlap
statement:
theorem exists_fg_two_away_localized_submodule_of_overlap
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {M : Type w} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    (r s : R)
    (Pr : Submodule (Localization.Away r) (LocalizedModule.Away r M))
    (Ps : Submodule (Localization.Away s) (LocalizedModule.Away s M))
    (hOverlap :
      let fr := LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers r) M
      let fs := LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers s) M
      let frs := LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers (r * s)) M
      ((Pr.restrictScalars R).comap fr).localized'
          (Localization.Away (r * s)) (Submonoid.powers (r * s)) frs =
        ((Ps.restrictScalars R).comap fs).localized'
          (Localization.Away (r * s)) (Submonoid.powers (r * s)) frs) :
    ∃ N : Submodule R M, N.FG ∧
      N.localized' (Localization.Away r) (Submonoid.powers r)
        (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers r) M) = Pr ∧
      N.localized' (Localization.Away s) (Submonoid.powers s)
        (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers s) M) = Ps

theorem signProjectionHom_apply [IsDomain R] (h𝓜 : IsPolynomialTwist 𝓜 d)

    (hγ : γ = Finsupp.single i₀ c + γ') (hγ' : γ' i₀ = 0)
    (z : DegreeZeroLocalization (polynomialGrading ι R)
      (𝓜) (.powers (MvPolynomial.monomial γ (1 : R)))) :
    signProjectionHom h𝓜 hγ hγ' z = signProjection h𝓜 hγ z

name: MvPolynomial.signProjection_add
statement:
theorem signProjection_add [IsDomain R] (h𝓜 : IsPolynomialTwist 𝓜 d)
    {γ γ' : ι →₀ ℕ} {i₀ : ι} {c : ℕ}
    (hγ : γ = Finsupp.single i₀ c + γ') (hγ' : γ' i₀ = 0)
    (z₁ z₂ : DegreeZeroLocalization (polynomialGrading ι R)
      (𝓜) (.powers (MvPolynomial.monomial γ (1 : R)))) :
    signProjection h𝓜 hγ (z₁ + z₂) = signProjection h𝓜 hγ z₁ + signProjection h𝓜 hγ z₂

name: MvPolynomial.signProjection_awayMk
statement:
theorem signProjection_awayMk [IsDomain R] (h𝓜 : IsPolynomialTwist 𝓜 d)
    {γ γ' : ι →₀ ℕ} {i₀ : ι} {c : ℕ}
    (hγ : γ = Finsupp.single i₀ c + γ') (hγ' : γ' i₀ = 0) {m : ℕ} {p : MvPolynomial ι R}
    (hp : p ∈ 𝓜 (m • γ.degree)) :
    signProjection h𝓜 hγ
        (DegreeZeroLocalization.awayMk (𝓜 := 𝓜)
          (monomial_one_mem_polynomialGrading (R := R) γ) m p hp) =
      DegreeZeroLocalization.awayMk (𝓜 := 𝓜)
        (monomial_one_mem_polynomialGrading (R := R) γ') m
        (MvPolynomial.divMonomial p (Finsupp.single i₀ (m * c)))
        (IsPolynomialTwist.divMonomial_mem h𝓜 hγ hp)

name: MvPolynomial.signProjection_frac
statement:
theorem signProjection_frac [IsDomain R] (h𝓜 : IsPolynomialTwist 𝓜 d)
    {γ γ' : ι →₀ ℕ} {i₀ : ι} {c : ℕ}
    (hγ : γ = Finsupp.single i₀ c + γ') (hγ' : γ' i₀ = 0) (r : AwayRep ι R 𝓜 γ) :
    signProjection h𝓜 hγ r.frac = (r.project h𝓜 hγ).frac

name: MvPolynomial.signProjection_laurentFace
statement:
theorem signProjection_laurentFace [IsDomain R] (h𝓜 : IsPolynomialTwist 𝓜 d)
    {γ γ' : ι →₀ ℕ} {i₀ : ι} {c : ℕ}
    (hγ : γ = Finsupp.single i₀ c + γ') (hγ' : γ' i₀ = 0)
    (z : DegreeZeroLocalization (polynomialGrading ι R)
      (𝓜) (.powers (MvPolynomial.monomial γ' (1 : R)))) :
    signProjection h𝓜 hγ (laurentFace 𝓜 hγ z) = z

name: MvPolynomial.signProjection_laurentFace_comm
statement:
theorem signProjection_laurentFace_comm [IsDomain R] (h𝓜 : IsPolynomialTwist 𝓜 d)
    {γ γ' δ δ' : ι →₀ ℕ} {i₀ e : ι}
    {c c' : ℕ} (hγ : γ = Finsupp.single i₀ c + γ') (hγ' : γ' i₀ = 0)
    (hδγ : δ = Finsupp.single e c' + γ) (hδγ' : δ' = Finsupp.single e c' + γ')
    (hδsplit : δ = Finsupp.single i₀ c + δ') (hδ'₀ : δ' i₀ = 0)
    (z : DegreeZeroLocalization (polynomialGrading ι R)
      (𝓜) (.powers (MvPolynomial.monomial γ (1 : R)))) :
    signProjection h𝓜 hδsplit (laurentFace 𝓜 hδγ z) =
      laurentFace 𝓜 hδγ' (signProjection h𝓜 hγ z)

name: MvPolynomial.AwayRep.frac_blockFilter_congr
statement:
theorem AwayRep.frac_blockFilter_congr [IsDomain R] (h𝓜 : IsPolynomialTwist 𝓜 d)

    {r₁ r₂ : AwayRep ι R 𝓜 γ} (h : r₁.frac = r₂.frac) :

name: MvPolynomial.AwayRep.frac_blockFilter_raise
statement:
theorem AwayRep.frac_blockFilter_raise (h𝓜 : IsPolynomialTwist 𝓜 d) {γ : ι →₀ ℕ}
    (F : Finset ι)
    (r : AwayRep ι R 𝓜 γ) (t : ℕ) :
    (r.blockFilter h𝓜 F).frac =
      DegreeZeroLocalization.awayMk (𝓜 := 𝓜)
        (monomial_one_mem_polynomialGrading (R := R) γ) (r.pow + t)
        (laurentFilter γ (r.pow + t) F ((MvPolynomial.monomial γ (1 : R)) ^ t * r.num))
        (IsPolynomialTwist.laurentFilter_mem h𝓜 (r.pow_mul_num_mem h𝓜 t))

name: MvPolynomial.IsPolynomialTwist.laurentFilter_mem

theorem blockProjHom_apply [IsDomain R] (h𝓜 : IsPolynomialTwist 𝓜 d) (γ : ι →₀ ℕ)

name: MvPolynomial.blockProj_awayMk
statement:
theorem blockProj_awayMk [IsDomain R] (h𝓜 : IsPolynomialTwist 𝓜 d) (γ : ι →₀ ℕ)
    (F : Finset ι) {m : ℕ}
    {p : MvPolynomial ι R}
    (hp : p ∈ 𝓜 (m • γ.degree)) :
    blockProj h𝓜 γ F
        (DegreeZeroLocalization.awayMk (𝓜 := 𝓜)

      DegreeZeroLocalization.awayMk (𝓜 := 𝓜)
        (monomial_one_mem_polynomialGrading (R := R) γ) m (laurentFilter γ m F p)
        (IsPolynomialTwist.laurentFilter_mem h𝓜 hp)

MvPolynomial.laurentHomotopy_awayMk
statement:
theorem laurentHomotopy_awayMk [IsDomain R] (h𝓜 : IsPolynomialTwist 𝓜 d) (i₀ : ι)
    (γ : ι →₀ ℕ) {m : ℕ}
    {q : MvPolynomial ι R}
    (hq : q ∈ 𝓜
      (m • (Finsupp.single i₀ 1 + γ).degree)) :
    laurentHomotopy h𝓜 i₀ γ
        (DegreeZeroLocalization.awayMk (𝓜 := 𝓜)
          (monomial_one_mem_polynomialGrading (R := R) (Finsupp.single i₀ 1 + γ)) m q hq) =
      DegreeZeroLocalization.awayMk (𝓜 := 𝓜)
        (monomial_one_mem_polynomialGrading (R := R) γ) m
        ((MvPolynomial.monomial (Finsupp.single i₀ (γ i₀)) (1 : R)) ^ m •
          MvPolynomial.divMonomial q (Finsupp.single i₀ (m * (1 + γ i₀))))
        (laurentHomotopy_numerator_mem h𝓜 i₀ γ hq)

theorem laurentHomotopy_back (i₀ : ι) (γ : ι →₀ ℕ) :

name: MvPolynomial.laurentHomotopy_laurentFace_blockProj
statement:
theorem laurentHomotopy_laurentFace_blockProj [IsDomain R] (h𝓜 : IsPolynomialTwist 𝓜 d)
    {i₀ : ι} {F : Finset ι} (hi₀ : i₀ ∉ F) (γ : ι →₀ ℕ)
    (z : DegreeZeroLocalization (polynomialGrading ι R)
      (𝓜) (.powers (MvPolynomial.monomial γ (1 : R)))) :
    laurentHomotopy h𝓜 i₀ γ
        (laurentFace 𝓜 (rfl : Finsupp.single i₀ 1 + γ = Finsupp.single i₀ 1 + γ)
          (blockProj h𝓜 γ F z)) =
      blockProj h𝓜 γ F z

name: MvPolynomial.laurentHomotopy_laurentFace_comm
statement:
theorem laurentHomotopy_laurentFace_comm [IsDomain R] (h𝓜 : IsPolynomialTwist 𝓜 d)
    (i₀ e : ι) (γ₀ : ι →₀ ℕ)
    (htop : Finsupp.single i₀ 1 + (γ₀ + Finsupp.single e 1) =
      Finsupp.single e 1 + (Finsupp.single i₀ 1 + γ₀))
    (hbot : γ₀ + Finsupp.single e 1 = Finsupp.single e 1 + γ₀)
    (z : DegreeZeroLocalization (polynomialGrading ι R)
      (𝓜)
      (.powers (MvPolynomial.monomial (Finsupp.single i₀ 1 + γ₀) (1 : R)))) :
    laurentHomotopy h𝓜 i₀ (γ₀ + Finsupp.single e 1) (laurentFace 𝓜 htop z) =
      laurentFace 𝓜 hbot (laurentHomotopy h𝓜 i₀ γ₀ z)

name: MvPolynomial.laurentHomotopy_numerator_mem
statement:
theorem laurentHomotopy_numerator_mem (h𝓜 : IsPolynomialTwist 𝓜 d) (i₀ : ι) (γ : ι →₀ ℕ)
    {m : ℕ}
    {q : MvPolynomial ι R}
    (hq : q ∈ 𝓜
      (m • (Finsupp.single i₀ 1 + γ).degree)) :
    (MvPolynomial.monomial (Finsupp.single i₀ (γ i₀)) (1 : R)) ^ m •
      MvPolynomial.divMonomial q (Finsupp.single i₀ (m * (1 + γ i₀))) ∈
      𝓜 (m • γ.degree)

theorem laurentHomotopy_split (i₀ : ι) (γ : ι →₀ ℕ) :

MvPolynomial.cechBlockProj_apply
statement:
theorem cechBlockProj_apply (h𝓜 : IsPolynomialTwist 𝓜 d) {n : ℕ}
    (x : Fin (n + 1) → ι) (F : Finset ι)
    (z : cechTerm ι k 𝓜 x) :
    cechBlockProj ι k h𝓜 x F z =
      (cechTermEquiv ι k 𝓜 x).symm
        (blockProj h𝓜 (tupleExponent ι x) F (cechTermEquiv ι k 𝓜 x z))

name: MvPolynomial.cechBlockProj_cechBlockProj_self
statement:
theorem cechBlockProj_cechBlockProj_self (h𝓜 : IsPolynomialTwist 𝓜 d) {n : ℕ}
    (x : Fin (n + 1) → ι) (F : Finset ι) (z : cechTerm ι k 𝓜 x) :
    cechBlockProj ι k h𝓜 x F (cechBlockProj ι k h𝓜 x F z) =
      cechBlockProj ι k h𝓜 x F z

name: MvPolynomial.cechBlockProj_eq_zero_of_not_subset
statement:
theorem cechBlockProj_eq_zero_of_not_subset (h𝓜 : IsPolynomialTwist 𝓜 d) {n : ℕ}

    {F : Finset ι} (h : ¬ F ⊆ (tupleExponent ι x).support)

name: MvPolynomial.cechFace_cechBlockProj
statement:
theorem cechFace_cechBlockProj (h𝓜 : IsPolynomialTwist 𝓜 d) {n : ℕ}
    (x : Fin (n + 2) → ι) (j : Fin (n + 2))
    (F : Finset ι) (z : cechTerm ι k 𝓜 (x ∘ j.succAbove)) :
    cechFace ι k 𝓜 x j (cechBlockProj ι k h𝓜 (x ∘ j.succAbove) F z) =
      cechBlockProj ι k h𝓜 x F (cechFace ι k 𝓜 x j z)

name: MvPolynomial.cechHomotopy_apply
statement:
theorem cechHomotopy_apply (h𝓜 : IsPolynomialTwist 𝓜 d) (i₀ : ι) {n : ℕ} (y : Fin (n + 1) → ι)
    (z : cechTerm ι k 𝓜 (Fin.cons i₀ y)) :
    cechHomotopy ι k h𝓜 i₀ y z =
      (cechTermEquiv ι k 𝓜 y).symm
        (laurentHomotopy h𝓜 i₀ (tupleExponent ι y)
          (DegreeZeroLocalization.powersCongr (tupleDenominator_cons_eq k i₀ y) z))

name: MvPolynomial.cechHomotopy_cechFace_succ
statement:
theorem cechHomotopy_cechFace_succ (h𝓜 : IsPolynomialTwist 𝓜 d) (i₀ : ι) {n : ℕ}
    (x : Fin (n + 2) → ι)
    (j : Fin (n + 2))
    (z : cechTerm ι k 𝓜 (Fin.cons i₀ (x ∘ j.succAbove))) :
    cechHomotopy ι k h𝓜 i₀ x
        (cechFace ι k 𝓜 (Fin.cons i₀ x) j.succ
          ((cechTermCongr ι k 𝓜 (cons_comp_succAbove_succ i₀ x j)).symm z)) =
      cechFace ι k 𝓜 x j
        (cechHomotopy ι k h𝓜 i₀ (x ∘ j.succAbove) z)

name: MvPolynomial.cechHomotopy_cechFace_zero
statement:
theorem cechHomotopy_cechFace_zero (h𝓜 : IsPolynomialTwist 𝓜 d) (i₀ : ι)
    {F : Finset ι} (hi₀ : i₀ ∉ F)
    {n : ℕ} (y : Fin (n + 1) → ι) (z : cechTerm ι k 𝓜 y) :
    cechHomotopy ι k h𝓜 i₀ y
        (cechFace ι k 𝓜 (Fin.cons i₀ y) 0
          ((cechTermCongr ι k 𝓜 (cons_comp_succAbove_zero i₀ y)).symm
            (cechBlockProj ι k h𝓜 y F z))) =
      cechBlockProj ι k h𝓜 y F z

name: MvPolynomial.cechTermCongr_apply_section
statement:
theorem cechTermCongr_apply_section (𝓜 : ℕ → σM)
    [SetLike.GradedSMul (polynomialGrading ι k) 𝓜] {n : ℕ}

name: MvPolynomial.cechTermCongr_cechBlockProj
statement:
theorem cechTermCongr_cechBlockProj (h𝓜 : IsPolynomialTwist 𝓜 d) {n : ℕ}

    (F : Finset ι) (z : cechTerm ι k 𝓜 x₁) :

name: MvPolynomial.cechTermCongr_symm_apply_section
statement:
theorem cechTermCongr_symm_apply_section (𝓜 : ℕ → σM)

    (s : ∀ x : Fin (n + 1) → ι, cechTerm ι k 𝓜 x)

name: MvPolynomial.cechTermEquiv_cechFace
statement:
theorem cechTermEquiv_cechFace (𝓜 : ℕ → σM)
    [SetLike.GradedSMul (polynomialGrading ι k) 𝓜] {n : ℕ} (x : Fin (n + 2) → ι) (j : Fin (n + 2))

name: MvPolynomial.cons_comp_succAbove_succ
statement:
theorem cons_comp_succAbove_succ {n : ℕ} (i₀ : ι) (x : Fin (n + 2) → ι) (j : Fin (n + 2)) :

name: MvPolynomial.cons_comp_succAbove_zero

name: MvPolynomial.laurentHomotopy_laurentFace_comm'
statement:
theorem laurentHomotopy_laurentFace_comm' (h𝓜 : IsPolynomialTwist 𝓜 d) (i₀ e : ι)
    {γ₀ γx : ι →₀ ℕ}
    (hγx : γx = γ₀ + Finsupp.single e 1)
    (htop : Finsupp.single i₀ 1 + γx = Finsupp.single e 1 + (Finsupp.single i₀ 1 + γ₀))
    (hbot : γx = Finsupp.single e 1 + γ₀)
    (z : DegreeZeroLocalization (polynomialGrading ι k)
      𝓜
      (.powers (MvPolynomial.monomial (Finsupp.single i₀ 1 + γ₀) (1 : k)))) :
    laurentHomotopy h𝓜 i₀ γx (laurentFace 𝓜 htop z) =
      laurentFace 𝓜 hbot (laurentHomotopy h𝓜 i₀ γ₀ z)

name: MvPolynomial.sum_cechBlockProj

theorem sum_cechBlockProj (h𝓜 : IsPolynomialTwist 𝓜 d) {n : ℕ} (x : Fin (n + 1) → ι)

theorem awayMk_eq_blockRep (γ : ι →₀ ℕ) {m : ℕ} {β : ι →₀ ℕ}

name: MvPolynomial.awayMk_smul
statement:
theorem awayMk_smul {d : ℤ} (h𝓜 : IsPolynomialTwist 𝓜 d) {f : MvPolynomial ι k} {e : ℕ}

name: MvPolynomial.blockProj_univ_mem_span

theorem blockProj_univ_mem_span [Fintype ι] {d : ℤ} (h𝓜 : IsPolynomialTwist 𝓜 d) (γ : ι →₀ ℕ)

MvPolynomial.cechBlockPrimitive_faces
statement:
theorem cechBlockPrimitive_faces (h𝓜 : IsPolynomialTwist 𝓜 d) {n : ℕ}
    (s : ∀ x : Fin (n + 2) → ι, cechTerm ι k 𝓜 x)
    (hs : ∀ x : Fin (n + 3) → ι,
      ∑ j : Fin (n + 3), (-1 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ) •
        cechFace ι k 𝓜 x j (s (x ∘ j.succAbove)) = 0)
    (hfull : ∀ {G : Finset ι}, (∀ j : ι, j ∈ G) →
      ∀ y : Fin (n + 2) → ι, cechBlockProj ι k h𝓜 y G (s y) = 0)
    (x : Fin (n + 2) → ι) (F : Finset ι) :
    ∑ j : Fin (n + 2), (-1 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ) •
        cechFace ι k 𝓜 x j
          (cechBlockPrimitive ι k h𝓜 F s (x ∘ j.succAbove)) =
      cechBlockProj ι k h𝓜 x F (s x)

name: MvPolynomial.cechBlockPrimitive_faces_of_exists
statement:
theorem cechBlockPrimitive_faces_of_exists (h𝓜 : IsPolynomialTwist 𝓜 d) {n : ℕ}
    (s : ∀ x : Fin (n + 2) → ι, cechTerm ι k 𝓜 x)
    (hs : ∀ x : Fin (n + 3) → ι,
      ∑ j : Fin (n + 3), (-1 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ) •
        cechFace ι k 𝓜 x j (s (x ∘ j.succAbove)) = 0)
    (x : Fin (n + 2) → ι) {F : Finset ι} (hF : ∃ i₀, i₀ ∉ F) :
    ∑ j : Fin (n + 2), (-1 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ) •
        cechFace ι k 𝓜 x j
          (cechBlockPrimitive ι k h𝓜 F s (x ∘ j.succAbove)) =
      cechBlockProj ι k h𝓜 x F (s x)

name: MvPolynomial.cechBlockPrimitive_of_exists
statement:
theorem cechBlockPrimitive_of_exists (h𝓜 : IsPolynomialTwist 𝓜 d) {n : ℕ} {F : Finset ι}
    (h : ∃ i₀, i₀ ∉ F)
    (s : ∀ x : Fin (n + 2) → ι, cechTerm ι k 𝓜 x)
    (y : Fin (n + 1) → ι) :
    cechBlockPrimitive ι k h𝓜 F s y =
      cechHomotopy ι k h𝓜 h.choose y
        (cechBlockProj ι k h𝓜 (Fin.cons h.choose y) F (s (Fin.cons h.choose y)))

name: MvPolynomial.cechBlockPrimitive_of_forall
statement:
theorem cechBlockPrimitive_of_forall (h𝓜 : IsPolynomialTwist 𝓜 d) {n : ℕ} {F : Finset ι}

    (s : ∀ x : Fin (n + 2) → ι, cechTerm ι k 𝓜 x)
    (y : Fin (n + 1) → ι) :
    cechBlockPrimitive ι k h𝓜 F s y = 0

name: MvPolynomial.cechBlockProj_eq_zero_of_forall_mem

name: MvPolynomial.cechPrimitive_isPrimitive
statement:
theorem cechPrimitive_isPrimitive (h𝓜 : IsPolynomialTwist 𝓜 d) {n : ℕ}
    (s : ∀ x : Fin (n + 2) → ι, cechTerm ι k 𝓜 x)
    (hs : ∀ x : Fin (n + 3) → ι,
      ∑ j : Fin (n + 3), (-1 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ) •
        cechFace ι k 𝓜 x j (s (x ∘ j.succAbove)) = 0)
    (hfull : ∀ {G : Finset ι}, (∀ j : ι, j ∈ G) →
      ∀ y : Fin (n + 2) → ι, cechBlockProj ι k h𝓜 y G (s y) = 0)
    (x : Fin (n + 2) → ι) :
    ∑ j : Fin (n + 2), (-1 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ) •
        cechFace ι k 𝓜 x j (cechPrimitive ι k h𝓜 s (x ∘ j.succAbove)) =

statement:
theorem saturatedQuotientMap_comp {C : Type*} [AddCommGroup B] [AddCommGroup C]
    (H : AddSubgroup A) (K : AddSubgroup B) (L : AddSubgroup C)
    (f : A →+ B) (g : B →+ C) (hf : H ≤ K.comap f) (hg : K ≤ L.comap g) :
    (K.saturatedQuotientMap L g hg).comp (H.saturatedQuotientMap K f hf) =

        intro x hx
        exact hg (hf hx))

    {T U V W : SchemeBaseChange S}

    (complexPullbackComp f (g ≫ h)).inv ≫
      CategoryTheory.Functor.whiskerRight (complexPullbackComp g h).inv _ ≫
        (CategoryTheory.Functor.associator _ _ _).hom ≫
          CategoryTheory.Functor.whiskerLeft _ (complexPullbackComp f g).hom ≫
            (complexPullbackComp (f ≫ g) h).hom =
      eqToHom (by simp)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.toddComp_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem toddComp_eq_zero_of_lt (V : NumericalVarietyData n A N)

name: DerivedAlgGeo.LinearAlgebra.gradedPiece_eq_bot

theorem gradedPiece_eq_bot (hw : ∀ i, w i ≤ n) {k : ℕ} (hk : n < k) :

name: DerivedAlgGeo.LinearAlgebra.gradedPiece_iSupIndep

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.degree_ch_mul_todd
statement:
theorem degree_ch_mul_todd (E : N) :
    V.ring.degree (V.ch E * V.todd)
      = ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1),
          V.ring.degree (V.chComp E i * V.toddComp (n - i))

name: Mukai.pairing_comm
statement:
theorem pairing_comm (hb : ∀ x y : M, b x y = b y x) (v w : R × M × R) :

name: Mukai.pairing_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pairing_mk (r : R) (c : M) (s : R) (r' : R) (c' : M) (s' : R) :
    pairing b (r, c, s) (r', c', s') = b c c' - r * s' - r' * s

name: Mukai.selfPairing_eq_pairing
statement:
theorem selfPairing_eq_pairing (v : R × M × R) :

name: Mukai.selfPairing_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem selfPairing_mk (r : R) (c : M) (s : R) :
    selfPairing b (r, c, s) = b c c - 2 * (r * s)

name: IntegralLattice.eq_zero_of_two_zsmul_eq_zero

name: Mukai.expectedDim_eq_zero_iff

name: Mukai.isIsotropic_corankUnit

name: Mukai.isIsotropic_iff
statement:
theorem isIsotropic_iff (v : MukaiLattice N) :

name: Mukai.isIsotropic_rankUnit
statement: theorem isIsotropic_rankUnit : IsIsotropic b (rankUnit : MukaiLattice N)

theorem isSpherical_iff (v : MukaiLattice N) :

name: Mukai.not_isSpherical_and_isIsotropic
statement:
theorem not_isSpherical_and_isIsotropic (v : MukaiLattice N) :

name: Mukai.pairingBilin_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pairingBilin_apply (v w : MukaiLattice N) :

name: Mukai.pairing_add_left
statement:
theorem pairing_add_left (u v w : MukaiLattice N) :
    pairing b (u + v) w = pairing b u w + pairing b v w

name: Mukai.pairing_add_right
statement:
theorem pairing_add_right (u v w : MukaiLattice N) :
    pairing b u (v + w) = pairing b u v + pairing b u w

name: Mukai.pairing_neg_left
statement:
theorem pairing_neg_left (v w : MukaiLattice N) :
    pairing b (-v) w = -pairing b v w

name: Mukai.pairing_neg_right
statement:
theorem pairing_neg_right (v w : MukaiLattice N) :

name: Mukai.pairing_outer
statement:
theorem pairing_outer (r s r' s' : ℤ) :
    pairing b ((r, (0 : N), s)) ((r', (0 : N), s')) = -(r * s' + r' * s)

name: Mukai.pairing_rankUnit_corankUnit
statement:
theorem pairing_rankUnit_corankUnit :
    pairing b (rankUnit : MukaiLattice N) corankUnit = -1

name: Mukai.pairing_smul_left
statement:
theorem pairing_smul_left (a : ℤ) (v w : MukaiLattice N) :
    pairing b (a • v) w = a * pairing b v w

name: Mukai.pairing_smul_right
statement:
theorem pairing_smul_right (a : ℤ) (v w : MukaiLattice N) :
    pairing b v (a • w) = a * pairing b v w

name: Mukai.pairing_sub_left
statement:
theorem pairing_sub_left (u v w : MukaiLattice N) :
    pairing b (u - v) w = pairing b u w - pairing b v w

name: Mukai.pairing_sub_right
statement:
theorem pairing_sub_right (u v w : MukaiLattice N) :
    pairing b u (v - w) = pairing b u v - pairing b u w

theorem pairing_zero_left (w : MukaiLattice N) : pairing b 0 w = 0

theorem pairing_zero_right (v : MukaiLattice N) : pairing b v 0 = 0

statement:
theorem selfPairing_neg (v : MukaiLattice N) :

statement:
theorem selfPairing_smul (a : ℤ) (v : MukaiLattice N) :

name: Mukai.selfPairing_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem selfPairing_zero : selfPairing b (0 : MukaiLattice N) = 0

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.degree_discriminant
statement:
theorem degree_discriminant (E : N) :
    V.ring.degree (V.discriminant E)
      = V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * V.chComp E 1)
        - 2 * (V.rank E : ℚ) * V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.discriminant_eq_selfPairing
statement:
theorem discriminant_eq_selfPairing (E : N) :
    V.discriminant E
      = Mukai.selfPairing (LinearMap.mul A A)
          (algebraMap ℚ A (V.rank E : ℚ), V.chComp E 1, V.chComp E 2)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.discriminant_mem_piece_two
statement:
theorem discriminant_mem_piece_two (E : N) :
    V.discriminant E ∈ V.ring.piece 2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Polarization.pow_mem
statement: theorem pow_mem (P : Polarization R) (i : ℕ) : P.cls ^ i ∈ R.piece i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.discDegH_eq
statement: theorem discDegH_eq (E : N) : discDegH V P E = V.ring.degree (V.discriminant E)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.discrH_eq
statement:
theorem discrH_eq (E : N) :
    discrH V P E = degH V P E ^ 2
      - 2 * V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 2) * (V.rank E : ℚ) * V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.discrH_eq_selfPairing
statement:
theorem discrH_eq_selfPairing (E : N) :
    discrH V P E
      = Mukai.selfPairing (LinearMap.mul ℚ ℚ)
          (V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 2) * (V.rank E : ℚ), degH V P E,
            V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.degHHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degHHom_apply (E : N) : degHHom V P E = degH V P E

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.degH_add
statement: theorem degH_add (E F : N) : degH V P (E + F) = degH V P E + degH V P F

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.discDegH_mul_mem
statement:
theorem discDegH_mul_mem (hn : 2 ≤ n) (E : N) :
    V.discriminant E * P.cls ^ (n - 2) ∈ V.ring.piece n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.slopeH_eq
statement: theorem slopeH_eq (E : N) : slopeH V P E = degH V P E / (V.rank E : ℚ)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.BField.along_cls
statement:
@[simp]
theorem along_cls (P : Polarization R) (β : ℚ) :
    (along P β).cls = algebraMap ℚ A β * P.cls

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.BField.pow_mem
statement: theorem pow_mem (B : BField R) (i : ℕ) : B.cls ^ i ∈ R.piece i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.chBComp_add
statement:
theorem chBComp_add (B : BField V.ring) (E F : N) (i : ℕ) :
    chBComp V B (E + F) i = chBComp V B E i + chBComp V B F i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.chBComp_along_eq_chBetaComp
statement:
theorem chBComp_along_eq_chBetaComp (β : ℚ) (E : N) (i : ℕ) :
    chBComp V (BField.along P β) E i = chBetaComp V P β E i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.chBComp_eq
statement:
theorem chBComp_eq (B : BField V.ring) (E : N) (i : ℕ) :
    chBComp V B E i =
      ∑ j ∈ range (i + 1),
        algebraMap ℚ A (twistCoeff 1 (i - j)) * V.chComp E j * B.cls ^ (i - j)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.chBComp_mem
statement:
theorem chBComp_mem (B : BField V.ring) (E : N) (i : ℕ) :
    chBComp V B E i ∈ V.ring.piece i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.chBComp_one
statement:
theorem chBComp_one (B : BField V.ring) (E : N) :
    chBComp V B E 1 = V.chComp E 1 - V.chComp E 0 * B.cls

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.chBComp_two
statement:
theorem chBComp_two (B : BField V.ring) (E : N) :
    chBComp V B E 2 =
      V.chComp E 2 - V.chComp E 1 * B.cls
        + algebraMap ℚ A (1 / 2) * V.chComp E 0 * B.cls ^ 2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.chBComp_zero
statement:
theorem chBComp_zero (B : BField V.ring) (E : N) :
    chBComp V B E 0 = V.chComp E 0

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.chBetaComp_add
statement:
theorem chBetaComp_add (β : ℚ) (E F : N) (i : ℕ) :
    chBetaComp V P β (E + F) i = chBetaComp V P β E i + chBetaComp V P β F i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.chBetaComp_add_beta
statement:
theorem chBetaComp_add_beta (β₁ β₂ : ℚ) (E : N) (i : ℕ) :
    chBetaComp V P (β₁ + β₂) E i = twist P.cls β₁ (chBetaComp V P β₂ E) i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.chBetaComp_eq
statement:
theorem chBetaComp_eq (β : ℚ) (E : N) (i : ℕ) :
    chBetaComp V P β E i
      = ∑ j ∈ range (i + 1),
        algebraMap ℚ A (twistCoeff β (i - j)) * V.chComp E j * P.cls ^ (i - j)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.chBetaComp_mem
statement:
theorem chBetaComp_mem (β : ℚ) (E : N) (i : ℕ) :
    chBetaComp V P β E i ∈ V.ring.piece i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.chBetaComp_zero_beta
statement:
theorem chBetaComp_zero_beta (E : N) (i : ℕ) :
    chBetaComp V P 0 E i = V.chComp E i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.twistCoeff_add
statement:
theorem twistCoeff_add (β₁ β₂ : ℚ) (m : ℕ) :
    twistCoeff (β₁ + β₂) m
      = ∑ a ∈ range (m + 1), twistCoeff β₁ a * twistCoeff β₂ (m - a)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.twistCoeff_zero_beta
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twistCoeff_zero_beta (m : ℕ) : twistCoeff 0 m = if m = 0 then 1 else 0

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.twist_add_beta
statement:
theorem twist_add_beta (H : A) (β₁ β₂ : ℚ) (c : ℕ → A) (i : ℕ) :
    twist H (β₁ + β₂) c i = twist H β₁ (twist H β₂ c) i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.twist_algebraMap_mul
statement:
theorem twist_algebraMap_mul (H : A) (β : ℚ) (c : ℕ → A) (i : ℕ) :
    twist (algebraMap ℚ A β * H) 1 c i = twist H β c i

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.Pullback.centralCharge_eq
statement:
theorem centralCharge_eq
    (h : Pullback source target) (a : ℝ) (E : L) :
    source.centralCharge a E = target.centralCharge a (h.map E)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.Pullback.centralCharge_twistByScalar_eq
statement:
theorem centralCharge_twistByScalar_eq
    (h : Pullback source target) (a b : ℝ) (E : L) :
    (source.twistByScalar b).centralCharge a E =
      (target.twistByScalar b).centralCharge a (h.map E)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.centralCharge_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem centralCharge_apply (a : ℝ) (E : N) :
    D.centralCharge a E =
      -Complex.ofReal (D.chTwo E)
        + Complex.ofReal (a ^ 2 * D.hyperplaneSquare * D.rank E / 2)
        + (a * Complex.I) * Complex.ofReal (D.degree E)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.centralCharge_im
statement:
theorem centralCharge_im (a : ℝ) (E : N) :
    (D.centralCharge a E).im = a * D.degree E

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.centralCharge_re
statement:
theorem centralCharge_re (a : ℝ) (E : N) :
    (D.centralCharge a E).re =
      -D.chTwo E + a ^ 2 * D.hyperplaneSquare * D.rank E / 2

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.centralCharge_twistByScalar_apply
statement:
theorem centralCharge_twistByScalar_apply (a b : ℝ) (E : N) :
    (D.twistByScalar b).centralCharge a E =
      -Complex.ofReal (D.chTwo E)
        + (b + a * Complex.I) * Complex.ofReal (D.degree E)
        - (b + a * Complex.I) ^ 2
            * Complex.ofReal (D.hyperplaneSquare * D.rank E / 2)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.centralCharge_zero
statement: theorem centralCharge_zero (a : ℝ) : D.centralCharge a 0 = 0

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.twistByScalar_chTwo
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twistByScalar_chTwo (b : ℝ) (E : N) :
    (D.twistByScalar b).chTwo E =
      D.chTwo E - b * D.degree E
        + b ^ 2 * D.hyperplaneSquare * D.rank E / 2

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.twistByScalar_degree
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twistByScalar_degree (b : ℝ) (E : N) :
    (D.twistByScalar b).degree E =
      D.degree E - b * D.hyperplaneSquare * D.rank E

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.twistByScalar_hyperplaneSquare
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twistByScalar_hyperplaneSquare (b : ℝ) :
    (D.twistByScalar b).hyperplaneSquare = D.hyperplaneSquare

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.twistByScalar_rank
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twistByScalar_rank (b : ℝ) (E : N) :
    (D.twistByScalar b).rank E = D.rank E

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.centralCharge_ofNumericalDataB_along_eq
statement:
theorem centralCharge_ofNumericalDataB_along_eq (V : NumericalVarietyData 2 A N)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.chTwoBHom_apply
statement:

theorem chTwoBHom_apply (V : NumericalVarietyData 2 A N)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.chTwoHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chTwoHom_apply (V : NumericalVarietyData 2 A N) (E : N) :

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.degreeBHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degreeBHom_apply (V : NumericalVarietyData 2 A N)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.degreeHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degreeHom_apply (V : NumericalVarietyData 2 A N)
    (P : Polarization V.ring) (E : N) :
    degreeHom V P E = ((degH V P E : ℚ) : ℝ)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.ofNumericalDataB_along_chTwo
statement:
theorem ofNumericalDataB_along_chTwo (V : NumericalVarietyData 2 A N)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.ofNumericalDataB_along_degree

theorem ofNumericalDataB_along_degree (V : NumericalVarietyData 2 A N)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.ofNumericalDataB_chTwo

theorem ofNumericalDataB_chTwo (V : NumericalVarietyData 2 A N)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.ofNumericalDataB_degree
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofNumericalDataB_degree (V : NumericalVarietyData 2 A N)

    (ofNumericalDataB V P B).degree E =

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.ofNumericalDataB_hyperplaneSquare
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofNumericalDataB_hyperplaneSquare (V : NumericalVarietyData 2 A N)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.ofNumericalDataB_rank
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofNumericalDataB_rank (V : NumericalVarietyData 2 A N)

    (ofNumericalDataB V P B).rank E = (V.rank E : ℝ)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.ofNumericalData_chTwo
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofNumericalData_chTwo (V : NumericalVarietyData 2 A N) (P : Polarization V.ring)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.centralCharge_apply
statement:
theorem centralCharge_apply
    (S : DivisorSpace D) (P : StabilityParameters D) (E : N) :
    ch.centralCharge S P E =
      Complex.ofReal
          (-ch.chTwo E + S.pair P.B (ch.chOne E)
            - (S.pair P.B P.B - S.pair P.omega P.omega) * ch.rank E / 2)
        + Complex.I * Complex.ofReal
            (S.pair P.omega (ch.chOne E) - S.pair P.omega P.B * ch.rank E)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.centralCharge_apply_twisted
statement:
theorem centralCharge_apply_twisted
    (S : DivisorSpace D) (P : StabilityParameters D) (E : N) :
    ch.centralCharge S P E =
      -Complex.ofReal ((ch.twist S P.B).chTwo E)
        + Complex.ofReal (S.pair P.omega P.omega * ch.rank E / 2)
        + Complex.I * Complex.ofReal
            (S.pair P.omega ((ch.twist S P.B).chOne E))

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.centralCharge_eq_realPairing
statement:
theorem centralCharge_eq_realPairing
    (S : DivisorSpace D) (P : StabilityParameters D) (E : N) :
    ch.centralCharge S P E =
      Complex.ofReal
          (Mukai.realPairing S.intersection
            (Mukai.expRe S.intersection P.B P.omega) (ch.toRealExtension E))
        + Complex.I * Complex.ofReal
          (Mukai.realPairing S.intersection
            (Mukai.expIm S.intersection P.B P.omega) (ch.toRealExtension E))

    (ch.coordinatesAt S H).degree E = S.pair H (ch.chOne E)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.coordinatesAt_hyperplaneSquare
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinatesAt_hyperplaneSquare (S : DivisorSpace D) (H : D) :
    (ch.coordinatesAt S H).hyperplaneSquare = S.pair H H

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.coordinatesAt_rank
statement:

theorem coordinatesAt_rank (S : DivisorSpace D) (H : D) (E : N) :
    (ch.coordinatesAt S H).rank E = ch.rank E

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.toRealExtension_apply
statement:

theorem toRealExtension_apply (E : N) :

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.twist_chOne
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twist_chOne (S : DivisorSpace D) (B : D) (E : N) :
    (ch.twist S B).chOne E = ch.chOne E - ch.rank E • B

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.twist_chTwo
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twist_chTwo (S : DivisorSpace D) (B : D) (E : N) :
    (ch.twist S B).chTwo E =
      ch.chTwo E - S.pair B (ch.chOne E) + S.pair B B * ch.rank E / 2

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.twist_rank
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twist_rank (S : DivisorSpace D) (B : D) (E : N) :
    (ch.twist S B).rank E = ch.rank E

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.centralCharge_eq_ofNumericalDataB
statement:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.chernCharacter_chOne
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chernCharacter_chOne (E : N) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.chernCharacter_chTwo
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chernCharacter_chTwo (E : N) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.chernCharacter_rank
statement:

theorem chernCharacter_rank (E : N) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.parameters_omega_square
statement:
theorem parameters_omega_square (P : Polarization V.ring)
    (B : BField V.ring) (a : ℝ) :
    R.divisorSpace.pair (R.parameters P B a).omega (R.parameters P B a).omega =
      a ^ 2 * ((V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 2) : ℚ) : ℝ)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.parameters_pair_twist_chOne
statement:
theorem parameters_pair_twist_chOne (P : Polarization V.ring)
    (B : BField V.ring) (a : ℝ) (E : N) :
    R.divisorSpace.pair (R.parameters P B a).omega
        ((R.chernCharacter.twist R.divisorSpace (R.realizeBField B)).chOne E) =
      a * ((V.ring.degree (chBComp V B E 1 * P.cls) : ℚ) : ℝ)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.twist_chOne_eq
statement:
theorem twist_chOne_eq (B : BField V.ring) (E : N) :
    (R.chernCharacter.twist R.divisorSpace (R.realizeBField B)).chOne E =
      R.divisorClass ⟨chBComp V B E 1, chBComp_mem V B E 1⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.twist_chTwo_eq
statement:
theorem twist_chTwo_eq (B : BField V.ring) (E : N) :
    (R.chernCharacter.twist R.divisorSpace (R.realizeBField B)).chTwo E =
      ((V.ring.degree (chBComp V B E 2) : ℚ) : ℝ)

statement:
theorem chi_eq (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E : N) :

statement:
theorem chi_eq_rank_add_mukaiS (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E : N) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.mukaiSelfPairing_eq
statement:
theorem mukaiSelfPairing_eq (E : N) :
    mukaiSelfPairing V E

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.mukaiSelfPairing_of_rank_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mukaiSelfPairing_of_rank_eq_zero (E : N) (hE : V.rank E = 0) :

statement: theorem chi₂_comm (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E F : N) : V.chi₂ E F = V.chi₂ F E

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.chi₂_eq_neg_mukaiPairing
statement:
theorem chi₂_eq_neg_mukaiPairing (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E F : N) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.chi₂_self
statement:
theorem chi₂_self (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E : N) :
    V.chi₂ E E = 2 * (V.rank E : ℚ) ^ 2 - V.ring.degree (V.discriminant E)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.mukaiPairing_comm
statement:
theorem mukaiPairing_comm (E F : N) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.mukaiPairing_self
statement:
theorem mukaiPairing_self (E : N) :

statement:
theorem chi₂_add_left (E F G : N) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.chi₂_add_right

theorem chi₂_add_right (E F G : N) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.chi₂_eq_degree_dual_ch
statement:
theorem chi₂_eq_degree_dual_ch (D : NumericalRingDualData V.ring) (E F : N) :
    V.chi₂ E F = V.ring.degree (D.dual (V.ch E) * V.ch F * V.todd)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.chi₂_eq_sum
statement:
theorem chi₂_eq_sum (E F : N) :
    V.chi₂ E F
      = ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1 - i),
          (-1 : ℚ) ^ i * V.ring.degree
            (V.chComp E i * V.chComp F j * V.toddComp (n - i - j))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.degree_algebraMap_mul_mul
statement:
theorem degree_algebraMap_mul_mul (q : ℚ) (x y : A) :
    V.ring.degree (algebraMap ℚ A q * x * y) = q * V.ring.degree (x * y)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.degree_chComp_mul_chComp_mul_toddComp_eq_zero
AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.degree_mul_algebraMap
statement:
theorem degree_mul_algebraMap (q : ℚ) (x : A) :
    V.ring.degree (x * algebraMap ℚ A q) = q * V.ring.degree x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.degree_mul_algebraMap_mul
statement:
theorem degree_mul_algebraMap_mul (q : ℚ) (x y : A) :
    V.ring.degree (x * algebraMap ℚ A q * y) = q * V.ring.degree (x * y)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.degree_smul_chComp_mul_chComp_mul_toddComp_eq_zero
AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.chi₂_eq
statement:
theorem chi₂_eq (E F : N) :
    V.chi₂ E F
      = (V.rank E : ℚ) * (V.rank F : ℚ) * V.ring.degree (V.toddComp 2)
        + (V.rank E : ℚ) * V.ring.degree (V.chComp F 1 * V.toddComp 1)
        - (V.rank F : ℚ) * V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * V.toddComp 1)
        + (V.rank E : ℚ) * V.ring.degree (V.chComp F 2)
        + (V.rank F : ℚ) * V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2)
        - V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * V.chComp F 1)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.chi₂_eq_chi_of_isStructureSheafLike
statement:
theorem chi₂_eq_chi_of_isStructureSheafLike (hV : V.SatisfiesHRR) (E F : N)
    (hr : V.rank E = 1) (h₁ : V.chComp E 1 = 0) (h₂ : V.chComp E 2 = 0) :
    V.chi₂ E F = (V.chi F : ℚ)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.chi₂_sub_chi₂_swap
statement:
theorem chi₂_sub_chi₂_swap (E F : N) :
    V.chi₂ E F - V.chi₂ F E
      = 2 * ((V.rank E : ℚ) * V.ring.degree (V.chComp F 1 * V.toddComp 1)
          - (V.rank F : ℚ) * V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * V.toddComp 1))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.chi₂_symm_of_toddComp_one_eq_zero
statement:
theorem chi₂_symm_of_toddComp_one_eq_zero (htd : V.toddComp 1 = 0) (E F : N) :
    V.chi₂ E F = V.chi₂ F E

theorem im_neg (p : P) (v : N) : Z.im p (-v) = -Z.im p v

theorem linearAct_charge (g : ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] ℂ) (p : P) (v : N) :

statement:
theorem map_eq_smul_add_smul (g : ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] ℂ) (z : ℂ) :

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.mem_zeroLocus
statement:

theorem mem_zeroLocus (p : P) (v : N) :

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.pullback_charge
statement:

theorem pullback_charge (f : M →+ N) (p : P) (v : M) :

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.pullback_id
statement:

theorem pullback_id : Z.pullback (AddMonoidHom.id N) = Z

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.pullback_zeroLocus
statement:
theorem pullback_zeroLocus (f : M →+ N) (v : M) :
    (Z.pullback f).zeroLocus v = Z.zeroLocus (f v)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.re_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem re_add (p : P) (v w : N) :

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.re_neg

theorem re_neg (p : P) (v : N) : Z.re p (-v) = -Z.re p v

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.re_zero
statement:

statement:

theorem realDet_mulLeft (c : ℂ) :

statement:

theorem reindex_charge (f : Q → P) (q : Q) :

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.reindex_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reindex_id : Z.reindex id = Z

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.reindex_pullback_charge
statement:
theorem reindex_pullback_charge (f : Q → P) (g : M →+ N) (q : Q) (v : M) :

statement:
theorem reindex_reindex {R : Type*} (f : Q → P) (g : R → Q) :

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.reindex_zeroLocus
statement:
theorem reindex_zeroLocus (f : Q → P) (v : N) :

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.smul_charge
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_charge (c : ℂ) (p : P) (v : N) :
    (Z.smul c).charge p v = c * Z.charge p v

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.stChargeFamily_charge
statement:
@[simp]
theorem stChargeFamily_charge (p : ℝ × ℝ) (v : NumClass) :
    stChargeFamily.charge p v =
      Complex.ofReal (reZ p.1 p.2 v) +
        Complex.I * Complex.ofReal (imZ p.1 p.2 v)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.stCharge_im
statement:
@[simp]
theorem stCharge_im (s t : ℝ) (v : NumClass) :
    (stCharge s t v).im = imZ s t v

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.stCharge_re
statement:
@[simp]
theorem stCharge_re (s t : ℝ) (v : NumClass) :
    (stCharge s t v).re = reZ s t v

statement:
theorem alignmentLocus_add_zsmul_right (n : ℤ) (v w : N) :

statement:
theorem alignmentLocus_smul {c : ℂ} (hc : c ≠ 0) (v w : N) :

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.alignmentLocus_swap
statement: theorem alignmentLocus_swap (v w : N) : Z.alignmentLocus w v = Z.alignmentLocus v w

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.alignmentValue_add_left
statement:
theorem alignmentValue_add_left (p : P) (v₁ v₂ w : N) :
    Z.alignmentValue p (v₁ + v₂) w =
      Z.alignmentValue p v₁ w + Z.alignmentValue p v₂ w

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.alignmentValue_add_nsmul_right
statement:
theorem alignmentValue_add_nsmul_right (p : P) (n : ℕ) (v w : N) :

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.alignmentValue_add_right
statement:
theorem alignmentValue_add_right (p : P) (v w₁ w₂ : N) :
    Z.alignmentValue p v (w₁ + w₂) =
      Z.alignmentValue p v w₁ + Z.alignmentValue p v w₂

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.alignmentValue_add_zsmul_right
statement:
theorem alignmentValue_add_zsmul_right (p : P) (n : ℤ) (v w : N) :
    Z.alignmentValue p v (w + n • v) = Z.alignmentValue p v w

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.alignmentValue_eq_neg_im_mul_conj
statement:
theorem alignmentValue_eq_neg_im_mul_conj (p : P) (v w : N) :
    Z.alignmentValue p v w =
      -((Z.charge p v) * conj (Z.charge p w)).im

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.alignmentValue_linearAct
statement:
theorem alignmentValue_linearAct (g : ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] ℂ) (p : P) (v w : N) :
    (Z.linearAct g).alignmentValue p v w = realDet g * Z.alignmentValue p v w

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.alignmentValue_neg_left
statement:
theorem alignmentValue_neg_left (p : P) (v w : N) :
    Z.alignmentValue p (-v) w = -Z.alignmentValue p v w

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.alignmentValue_neg_right
statement:
theorem alignmentValue_neg_right (p : P) (v w : N) :
    Z.alignmentValue p v (-w) = -Z.alignmentValue p v w

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.alignmentValue_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem alignmentValue_self (p : P) (v : N) : Z.alignmentValue p v v = 0

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.alignmentValue_smul
statement:
theorem alignmentValue_smul (c : ℂ) (p : P) (v w : N) :
    (Z.smul c).alignmentValue p v w = Complex.normSq c * Z.alignmentValue p v w

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.alignmentValue_swap
statement:
theorem alignmentValue_swap (p : P) (v w : N) :

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.alignmentValue_zero_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem alignmentValue_zero_left (p : P) (w : N) : Z.alignmentValue p 0 w = 0

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.alignmentValue_zero_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem alignmentValue_zero_right (p : P) (v : N) : Z.alignmentValue p v 0 = 0

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.alignmentValue_zsmul_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem alignmentValue_zsmul_right (p : P) (n : ℤ) (v : N) :
    Z.alignmentValue p v (n • v) = 0

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.mem_alignmentLocus
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_alignmentLocus (p : P) (v w : N) :
    p ∈ Z.alignmentLocus v w ↔ Z.alignmentValue p v w = 0

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.mem_positiveRayLocus
statement:
theorem mem_positiveRayLocus (p : P) (v w : N) :
    p ∈ Z.positiveRayLocus v w ↔
      Z.charge p v ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Z.charge p w = (r : ℂ) * Z.charge p v

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.positiveRayLocus_subset_alignmentLocus
statement:
theorem positiveRayLocus_subset_alignmentLocus (v w : N) :
    Z.positiveRayLocus v w ⊆ Z.alignmentLocus v w

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.pullback_alignmentLocus
statement:
theorem pullback_alignmentLocus (f : M →+ N) (v w : M) :
    (Z.pullback f).alignmentLocus v w = Z.alignmentLocus (f v) (f w)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.pullback_alignmentValue
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pullback_alignmentValue (f : M →+ N) (p : P) (v w : M) :
    (Z.pullback f).alignmentValue p v w = Z.alignmentValue p (f v) (f w)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.reindex_alignmentLocus
statement:
theorem reindex_alignmentLocus (f : Q → P) (v w : N) :
