name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.zeroLocus_subset_alignmentLocus_left
statement:
theorem zeroLocus_subset_alignmentLocus_left (v w : N) :
    Z.zeroLocus v ⊆ Z.alignmentLocus v w

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.zeroLocus_subset_alignmentLocus_right
statement:
theorem zeroLocus_subset_alignmentLocus_right (v w : N) :
    Z.zeroLocus w ⊆ Z.alignmentLocus v w

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.charge_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem charge_eq_zero_iff {s t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) (v : NumClass) :
    (reZ s t v = 0 ∧ imZ s t v = 0) ↔
      (v.deg = s * v.rk ∧ v.ch2 = ((s ^ 2 + t ^ 2) / 2) * v.rk)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.crossAB_swap
statement:
theorem crossAB_swap (v w₁ w₂ : NumClass) :
    crossAB v w₂ w₁ = -crossAB v w₁ w₂

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.crossAC_swap
statement:
theorem crossAC_swap (v w₁ w₂ : NumClass) :
    crossAC v w₂ w₁ = -crossAC v w₁ w₂

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.crossBC_swap
statement:
theorem crossBC_swap (v w₁ w₂ : NumClass) :
    crossBC v w₂ w₁ = -crossBC v w₁ w₂

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.degV_charge_eq_zero
statement: theorem degV_charge_eq_zero : reZ 0 1 degV = 0 ∧ imZ 0 1 degV = 0

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.eq_of_two_walls
statement:
theorem eq_of_two_walls {s t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) {v w₁ w₂ : NumClass}
    (h₁ : wallExpr s t v w₁ = 0) (h₂ : wallExpr s t v w₂ = 0)
    (hD : minA v w₁ * minB v w₂ - minA v w₂ * minB v w₁ ≠ 0) :
    s = -(minA v w₁ * minC v w₂ - minA v w₂ * minC v w₁)
          / (minA v w₁ * minB v w₂ - minA v w₂ * minB v w₁)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.minA_shift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem minA_shift (k : ℝ) (v w : NumClass) : minA v (shift k v w) = minA v w

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.minB_shift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem minB_shift (k : ℝ) (v w : NumClass) : minB v (shift k v w) = minB v w

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.minC_shift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem minC_shift (k : ℝ) (v w : NumClass) : minC v (shift k v w) = minC v w

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.minorCross_eq_zero_of_two_walls
statement:
theorem minorCross_eq_zero_of_two_walls {s t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) {v w₁ w₂ : NumClass}
    (hv : ¬(reZ s t v = 0 ∧ imZ s t v = 0))
    (h₁ : wallExpr s t v w₁ = 0) (h₂ : wallExpr s t v w₂ = 0) :
    crossAB v w₁ w₂ = 0 ∧ crossAC v w₁ w₂ = 0 ∧ crossBC v w₁ w₂ = 0

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.minor_orth
statement:
theorem minor_orth (v w : NumClass) :
    v.ch2 * minA v w + v.deg * minB v w + v.rk * minC v w = 0

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.wallExpr_eq
statement:
theorem wallExpr_eq (s t : ℝ) (v w : NumClass) :
    wallExpr s t v w
      = t * (minC v w + s * minB v w + ((s ^ 2 + t ^ 2) / 2) * minA v w)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.wallExpr_shift
statement:
theorem wallExpr_shift (s t k : ℝ) (v w : NumClass) :
    wallExpr s t v (shift k v w) = wallExpr s t v w

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.wall_circle_eq
statement:
theorem wall_circle_eq {s t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) {v w : NumClass}
    (hA : minA v w ≠ 0) :
    wallExpr s t v w = 0 ↔
      (minA v w * s + minB v w) ^ 2 + (minA v w * t) ^ 2
        = minB v w ^ 2 - 2 * minA v w * minC v w

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.wall_eq_of_meet
statement:
theorem wall_eq_of_meet {s t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) {v w₁ w₂ : NumClass}
    (hv : ¬(reZ s t v = 0 ∧ imZ s t v = 0))
    (h₁ : wallExpr s t v w₁ = 0) (h₂ : wallExpr s t v w₂ = 0)
    (hn₁ : ¬(minA v w₁ = 0 ∧ minB v w₁ = 0 ∧ minC v w₁ = 0))
    (hn₂ : ¬(minA v w₂ = 0 ∧ minB v w₂ = 0 ∧ minC v w₂ = 0))
    {s' t' : ℝ} (ht' : t' ≠ 0) :
    wallExpr s' t' v w₁ = 0 ↔ wallExpr s' t' v w₂ = 0

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.wall_eq_of_meet_needs_charge
statement:
theorem wall_eq_of_meet_needs_charge :
    ∃ w₁ w₂ : NumClass,
      wallExpr 0 1 degV w₁ = 0 ∧ wallExpr 0 1 degV w₂ = 0 ∧
      ¬(minA degV w₁ = 0 ∧ minB degV w₁ = 0 ∧ minC degV w₁ = 0) ∧
      ¬(minA degV w₂ = 0 ∧ minB degV w₂ = 0 ∧ minC degV w₂ = 0) ∧
      wallExpr 0 2 degV w₂ = 0 ∧ wallExpr 0 2 degV w₁ ≠ 0

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.wall_iff_circle
statement:
theorem wall_iff_circle {s t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) (v w : NumClass) :
    wallExpr s t v w = 0 ↔
      minA v w * (s ^ 2 + t ^ 2) + 2 * minB v w * s + 2 * minC v w = 0

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.wall_line_eq
CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.wall_subset_of_crossZero
statement:
theorem wall_subset_of_crossZero {v w₁ w₂ : NumClass}
    (hAB : crossAB v w₁ w₂ = 0) (hAC : crossAC v w₁ w₂ = 0) (hBC : crossBC v w₁ w₂ = 0)
    (hn : ¬(minA v w₁ = 0 ∧ minB v w₁ = 0 ∧ minC v w₁ = 0))
    {s t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) (h : wallExpr s t v w₁ = 0) :
    wallExpr s t v w₂ = 0

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.mem_stChargeFamily_alignmentLocus
statement:
theorem mem_stChargeFamily_alignmentLocus (p : ℝ × ℝ) (v w : NumClass) :
    p ∈ stChargeFamily.alignmentLocus v w ↔ wallExpr p.1 p.2 v w = 0

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.stChargeFamily_alignmentValue
statement:
@[simp]
theorem stChargeFamily_alignmentValue (p : ℝ × ℝ) (v w : NumClass) :
    stChargeFamily.alignmentValue p v w = wallExpr p.1 p.2 v w

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.NumClass.discr_eq
statement: theorem discr_eq (v : NumClass) : v.discr = v.deg ^ 2 - 2 * v.rk * v.ch2

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.NumClass.discr_eq_selfPairing
statement:
theorem discr_eq_selfPairing (v : NumClass) :
    v.discr = Mukai.selfPairing (LinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) v

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.NumClass.discr_of_rk_eq_zero
statement: theorem discr_of_rk_eq_zero {v : NumClass} (h : v.rk = 0) : v.discr = v.deg ^ 2

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.NumClass.discr_scale
statement: theorem discr_scale (c : ℝ) (v : NumClass) : (scale c v).discr = c ^ 2 * v.discr

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.NumClass.scale_ch2
statement:
@[simp]
theorem scale_ch2 (c : ℝ) (v : NumClass) : (scale c v).ch2 = c * v.ch2

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.NumClass.scale_deg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem scale_deg (c : ℝ) (v : NumClass) : (scale c v).deg = c * v.deg

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.NumClass.scale_rk
statement:

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.nested_of_offsets
statement:
theorem nested_of_offsets {a₁ a₂ k : ℝ} (hk0 : 0 ≤ k)
    (h₁ : k ≤ a₁ ^ 2) (h₂ : k ≤ a₂ ^ 2) (hfam : 0 < a₁ * a₂) :
    (a₂ - a₁) ^ 2 ≤ (a₁ ^ 2 - k) + (a₂ ^ 2 - k) ∧
      4 * (a₁ ^ 2 - k) * (a₂ ^ 2 - k) ≤
        ((a₂ - a₁) ^ 2 - (a₁ ^ 2 - k) - (a₂ ^ 2 - k)) ^ 2

statement:
theorem nesting_identity (a₁ a₂ k : ℝ) :

theorem wallCentre_eq (v w : NumClass) : wallCentre v w = -(minB v w) / minA v w

statement:
theorem wallCentre_eq_sub_offset (v w : NumClass) :

statement:
@[simp]
theorem wallRadiusSq_eq (v w : NumClass) :
    wallRadiusSq v w = (minB v w ^ 2 - 2 * minA v w * minC v w) / minA v w ^ 2

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.wallRadiusSq_eq_offset
statement:
theorem wallRadiusSq_eq_offset {v w : NumClass} (hrk : v.rk ≠ 0) (hA : minA v w ≠ 0) :
    wallRadiusSq v w = wallOffset v w ^ 2 - v.discr / v.rk ^ 2

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.walls_nested_of_discr_nonneg
statement:
theorem walls_nested_of_discr_nonneg {v w₁ w₂ : NumClass}
    (hrk : v.rk ≠ 0) (hdisc : 0 ≤ v.discr)
    (hA₁ : minA v w₁ ≠ 0) (hA₂ : minA v w₂ ≠ 0)
    (hR₁ : 0 ≤ wallRadiusSq v w₁) (hR₂ : 0 ≤ wallRadiusSq v w₂)
    (hfam : 0 < wallOffset v w₁ * wallOffset v w₂) :
    (wallCentre v w₁ - wallCentre v w₂) ^ 2 ≤ wallRadiusSq v w₁ + wallRadiusSq v w₂ ∧
      4 * wallRadiusSq v w₁ * wallRadiusSq v w₂ ≤
        ((wallCentre v w₁ - wallCentre v w₂) ^ 2
          - wallRadiusSq v w₁ - wallRadiusSq v w₂) ^ 2

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.walls_not_nested_of_opposite_offset
statement:
theorem walls_not_nested_of_opposite_offset :
    ∃ v w₁ w₂ : NumClass,
      v.rk ≠ 0 ∧ 0 ≤ v.discr ∧ minA v w₁ ≠ 0 ∧ minA v w₂ ≠ 0 ∧
      0 ≤ wallRadiusSq v w₁ ∧ 0 ≤ wallRadiusSq v w₂ ∧
      wallOffset v w₁ * wallOffset v w₂ < 0 ∧
      ¬((wallCentre v w₁ - wallCentre v w₂) ^ 2
        ≤ wallRadiusSq v w₁ + wallRadiusSq v w₂)

statement:
theorem wall_eq_of_meet_of_semistable {E : N} (B : BogomolovGiesekerData V P)

    {s t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) {w₁ w₂ : Wall.NumClass}
    (h₁ : Wall.wallExpr s t (toNumClass V P E) w₁ = 0)
    (h₂ : Wall.wallExpr s t (toNumClass V P E) w₂ = 0)
    (hn₁ : ¬(Wall.minA (toNumClass V P E) w₁ = 0 ∧ Wall.minB (toNumClass V P E) w₁ = 0
      ∧ Wall.minC (toNumClass V P E) w₁ = 0))
    (hn₂ : ¬(Wall.minA (toNumClass V P E) w₂ = 0 ∧ Wall.minB (toNumClass V P E) w₂ = 0
      ∧ Wall.minC (toNumClass V P E) w₂ = 0))
    {s' t' : ℝ} (ht' : t' ≠ 0) :
    Wall.wallExpr s' t' (toNumClass V P E) w₁ = 0
      ↔ Wall.wallExpr s' t' (toNumClass V P E) w₂ = 0

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.walls_nested_of_semistable
statement:
theorem walls_nested_of_semistable {E : N} (B : BogomolovGiesekerData V P)
    (hI : HodgeIndexStatement V P) (hE : B.Semistable E)
    (hrk : (toNumClass V P E).rk ≠ 0) {w₁ w₂ : Wall.NumClass}
    (hA₁ : Wall.minA (toNumClass V P E) w₁ ≠ 0)
    (hA₂ : Wall.minA (toNumClass V P E) w₂ ≠ 0)
    (hR₁ : 0 ≤ Wall.wallRadiusSq (toNumClass V P E) w₁)
    (hR₂ : 0 ≤ Wall.wallRadiusSq (toNumClass V P E) w₂)
    (hfam : 0 < Wall.wallOffset (toNumClass V P E) w₁
      * Wall.wallOffset (toNumClass V P E) w₂) :
    (Wall.wallCentre (toNumClass V P E) w₁
          - Wall.wallCentre (toNumClass V P E) w₂) ^ 2
        ≤ Wall.wallRadiusSq (toNumClass V P E) w₁
          + Wall.wallRadiusSq (toNumClass V P E) w₂ ∧
      4 * Wall.wallRadiusSq (toNumClass V P E) w₁
          * Wall.wallRadiusSq (toNumClass V P E) w₂
        ≤ ((Wall.wallCentre (toNumClass V P E) w₁
              - Wall.wallCentre (toNumClass V P E) w₂) ^ 2
          - Wall.wallRadiusSq (toNumClass V P E) w₁
          - Wall.wallRadiusSq (toNumClass V P E) w₂) ^ 2

Mukai.expChargeHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem expChargeHom_apply (v : RealExtension V) :
    expChargeHom b β ω v = expCharge b β ω v

name: Mukai.expChargeLinearMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem expChargeLinearMap_apply (v : RealExtension V) :
    expChargeLinearMap b β ω v = expCharge b β ω v

name: Mukai.expCharge_add
statement:
theorem expCharge_add (v w : Mukai.RealExtension V) :
    Mukai.expCharge b β ω (v + w) =
      Mukai.expCharge b β ω v + Mukai.expCharge b β ω w

name: Mukai.expCharge_apply
statement:
theorem expCharge_apply (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x) (r : ℝ) (c : V) (s : ℝ) :
    expCharge b β ω (r, c, s)
      = Complex.ofReal (b β c - s - r * (b β β - b ω ω) / 2)
        + Complex.ofReal (b ω c - r * b β ω) * Complex.I

name: Mukai.expCharge_ne_zero_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem expCharge_ne_zero_of_nonneg
    (hsig : PeriodDomain.HasSignatureTwo (realForm b)) (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x)
    (hω : 0 < b ω ω) {v : RealExtension V} (hv : 0 ≤ realForm b v) (hv0 : v ≠ 0) :
    expCharge b β ω v ≠ 0

name: Mukai.expCharge_neg
statement:
theorem expCharge_neg (v : Mukai.RealExtension V) :
    Mukai.expCharge b β ω (-v) = -Mukai.expCharge b β ω v

name: Mukai.expCharge_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem expCharge_zero : Mukai.expCharge b β ω 0 = 0

name: Mukai.neg_of_expCharge_eq_zero
statement:
theorem neg_of_expCharge_eq_zero
    (hsig : PeriodDomain.HasSignatureTwo (realForm b)) (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x)
    (hω : 0 < b ω ω) {v : RealExtension V} (hv : expCharge b β ω v = 0) (hv0 : v ≠ 0) :
    realForm b v < 0
